Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. = Can I explain something, folks? I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer. Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you so much for sticking by me. _Below is a message from Jonathan Nez, who is running for Congress in Arizona's 2nd district._
* * *
Hi, Across the US, our Native American communities have historically suffered at the hands of our federal government — forced from their ancestral homelands in a brutal genocide that stains our nation to this day. Here on Navajo Nation, our people’s roots run deep: we are a rare example of a tribe that retains access to our ancestral lands. Despite the history of our government’s oppression towards America’s native peoples, we have consistently demonstrated patriotism of the highest order: serving in our armed forces at a disproportionately high rate, stewarding some of our nation’s most beautiful landscapes, and so much more. # Latinos Save America
---
We would like to invite you all to our session one training on Tuesday, August 13, 2024 at 7:00 PM Central Time via zoom. We are excited to have received an overwhelming number of patriots across the country who want to be empowered to activate in their communities. We have a proven record. We are excited to pass along our wealth of knowledge. Our goal is to develop as many grassroots activist and leaders in this country that are going to help us Save America. Session One:
Part 1. Mobilizing Your Community: This session will cover the importance of community engagement, effective communication strategies, and how to organize local events to mobilize voters. Part 2. Voter Registration and Education: This session will provide training on voter registration processes, voter education, and how to address common barriers to voting. This is a 1 hour training, if you are interested in attending this training via zoom, please respond to this email. We will send out the zoom link along with a Volunteer Guide. We thank you all for stepping up to the plate and we look forward to seeing you all on Tuesday.

Friend – I’ve worked in politics for half a century, so believe me when I tell you: **Democrats are in BIG trouble.**

The 2024 Senate map is the toughest one I’ve ever seen. Our razor-thin majority is hanging on by a single thread, and there’s no question that GOP extremists will use every trick up their sleeves to snatch back power.
**The GOP is coming at us with full force – and with experts saying that Nevada could once again decide Senate control, they’re zeroing in on Jacky Rosen as a TOP target for defeat. Polling shows the Nevada Senate race in a statistical dead heat!!! It’s not looking good, friend.**
**[Jacky needs to raise another $10,193 by midnight tonight to fight back against GOP attacks and fuel her campaign forward – but the ONLY way she can get there is with your immediate grassroots support. So PLEASE, will you chip in $5 or more now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90647291/491236140/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4527-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZmM4NTM0NC00ZjU4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jpL3KINJiQzvyABU1JM1KliSuat73468rueTYZdsRu0=)**
Democrats won in Nevada by less than 1% in 2022, making it the closest Senate race in the entire country. Now that they have a second chance at winning in Nevada, Republicans aren’t going to leave anything up to chance – and they’re already pulling out all of the stops to flip this seat.
**If Jacky loses in Nevada, the ****GOP extremists will take back the majority and enact their dangerous, out-of-touch agenda. We CANNOT let this happen.**

In my expert opinion, we CAN win this race and keep control of the Senate – but that starts with raising the resources, today, to prepare for the tough fight ahead.
**[So please, friend, I’m asking you one more time before the midnight deadline: Will you chip in now – as much as you can spare – to help Jacky win in Nevada and defend our majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90647292/491236141/1398942472?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4527-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZmM4NTM0NC00ZjU4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jpL3KINJiQzvyABU1JM1KliSuat73468rueTYZdsRu0=)**
Thank you for being part of this incredible team. I’ve seen many grassroots campaigns in my lifetime, and I know this one has what it takes to win.

– James Carville

# Competitor Charlene Nijmeh to Endorse
# Congressional Candidate Peter Hernandez
** Note Time Change **
---
| | | | [](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cb9DXWopLHi_JhSiO0gl8L5d4OVaF7v5xyFRjD6x1bsGcx_R1B-M3fBIvqxC8qoDUpXsj8FX_ZJj99I3nyjZWjzJjf168muCE6OVn4ctjSpL8i2QHIqpQHViNIgcjTryuX8lUbDB0t9Id2XU7GiyNuGEhs8U-Ok05qzaz2cPyLv-kwOQx_JgtOQqfkrkqbdS&c=fyuxdjeYjlfSeHe06lFbZPD8uYV4-Oya5By8blz5Zm1vLQ8E5S2iTA==&ch=IHNA1rakIkviyF61WRUjQ9Jw6fC1XjXEYYnCmJO7BsZxfEcngVytXw==)
---
In the March Primary Peter Hernandez and Zoe Lofgren finished in the TOP 2 and are running for Congressional District 18 in the November election. Finishing third in March was Democrat Charlene Nijmeh who managed to take 11% of the vote away from Lofgren.

Charlene Nijmeh is the Tribal Chairwoman of the Muwekma Ohlone Tribe. The Ohlones are the indigenous people of the Bay Area who are frustrated trying to work with Lofgren. The longtime congresswoman is the subject of intense criticism for her mistreatment of the Tribe, which includes a January 2023 conversation on Capitol Hill in which Lofgren demanded that Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh sign away a vast swath of the Tribe's rights and freedoms in exchange for legislation that would correct the federal government's mistake.
On Tuesday, August 13th, on the steps of San Jose City Hall, the Muwekma Ohlone Tribe will hold a rally at 4 PM, at which Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh will endorse a REPUBLICAN, Peter Hernandez, over the DEMOCRAT, Zoe Lofgren. This endorsement is a game changer for the Hernandez Campaign.

Chairwoman Nijmeh and other tribal members will be arriving by horseback at City Hall at 4:00 pm Tuesday afternoon. She'll be accompanied by The Low Riders and a motorcycle club. They will depart Emma Prusch Park toward City Hall at 3:00 pm, heading up King Road to Santa Clara Street, and then Santa Clara Street to City Hall. It should take about an hour to walk to City Hall. You're welcome to walk along if you're up for it, or meet them outside City Hall at 4PM.
If you caught [Channel 7 ABC News on Monday](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cb9DXWopLHi_JhSiO0gl8L5d4OVaF7v5xyFRjD6x1bsGcx_R1B-M3fBIvqxC8qoDUpXsj8FX_ZJj99I3nyjZWjzJjf168muCE6OVn4ctjSpL8i2QHIqpQHViNIgcjTryuX8lUbDB0t9Id2XU7GiyNuGEhs8U-Ok05qzaz2cPyLv-kwOQx_JgtOQqfkrkqbdS&c=fyuxdjeYjlfSeHe06lFbZPD8uYV4-Oya5By8blz5Zm1vLQ8E5S2iTA==&ch=IHNA1rakIkviyF61WRUjQ9Jw6fC1XjXEYYnCmJO7BsZxfEcngVytXw==), you saw Tribal Chairwoman Nijmeh lead a caravan of horses over the Golden Gate Bridge as they start their trek to Washington, DC to protest Lofgren. Riding on horseback, the Tribe will be participating in the August 13th rally at 4 PM.
Please join us at San Jose City Hall, 200 E. Santa Clara St., San Jose, and participate in this event! If you're interested in hearing more about the event, join a Zoom meeting the evening before by clicking this link.
This will be a fun event!! Come out and support Peter Hernandez and invite your friends!!
| | [For More Info Click Here Monday, 8/12 at 6PM to Join Our Zoom Meeting](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cb9DXWopLHi_JhSiO0gl8L5d4OVaF7v5xyFRjD6x1bsGcx_R1B-M3QYvyMXm0SQ9deJ5zv8qM1yi5eyoNW3ltBH5lz8q-nDUamKSDWreBGOntlk_q2-Jz_CYQ0N3Gu6TsRv8aBj-SWJXsuDLfHGcgC2x2_P8NdCMprLzcSR8kOY=&c=fyuxdjeYjlfSeHe06lFbZPD8uYV4-Oya5By8blz5Zm1vLQ8E5S2iTA==&ch=IHNA1rakIkviyF61WRUjQ9Jw6fC1XjXEYYnCmJO7BsZxfEcngVytXw==)

# ICYMI:
---
|
# When they stalk our children,
# the government has gone too far.
---
| | | | |
---|---
### Candidates spend thousands (and even millions) of dollars on a marketing "Focus Group" to come up with campaign phrases that will catch the attention of voters. Instead of spending big bucks on a marketing consultant, I sat around the table with 15 members of my large Mexican family celebrating my brother's birthday.
My family is the perfect focus group. We are a mixture of Republicans and Democrats and enjoy many spirited discussions. When it came to talk about our children, both factions reached the non-partisan conclusion that "the government has gone too far" when they come for our kids.
The government now makes it official that they want a separation between parents and their children! The government thinks they can raise your children better than you can!
I believe that, "When they stalk our children, the government has gone too far." is a unifying message that will put common sense Democrats and Republicans on the same page. Please help me get this message out so that I can carry your voice to Congress and join with a new Republican Administration to clean up the mess LEFT by the LEFT.

Cuando acosan a nuestro hijos,
el gobierno ha ido demasiado lejos.
| | | |
---

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: WOW - what a run!
body:
The votes are counted, the dust has settled, and while I was not the victor in this race, I sure feel like a winner.
* I won 3 out of 5 counties.
* At last count, over 23,000 voters chose me.
* I kept the gap between myself and my very well-funded, DC backed opponent to nearly 3,000 votes.

When I started down this path, I knew it would be bumpy, full of twists and turns; I KNEW I would not be the candidate that Washington DC would back. _So, I set out with eyes wide open and mind clear knowing that I must do things differently._

Over the past 18 months, I have worked tirelessly to win over the grassroots, and by all accounts, I do believe I accomplished that goal.

**My heart is full of gratitude for YOU.** You believed in me, you donated, and gave countless hours of your time. Together, we created a movement and it was pretty awesome to be a part of it.

Grantland Rice wrote, "It's not whether you win or lose, but how you play the game". I am happy and proud of what WE accomplished. Thank you for your support and encouragement.

I am not making any decisions right now about what the future holds, I plan on taking the next couple of months to rest, reflect, and pray. I also plan on sticking around to help my friends who we need to get across the finish line in November.

Lasty, I wish Dr. Reddy all the best in his campaign to defeat Sharice Davids in November.

I will be closing down this email, for now, so if you would like to stay in touch, please do so by using my personal email [kcrnkovich@gmail.com](mailto:kcrnkovich@gmail.com).

Thank you! This has been the ride of a lifetime and I am so grateful that you were a part of it.

Best regards,____
Karen Crnkovich for Congress, KS03 ____
[www.kcforkansas.com](https://kcforkansas-com.dmailroute.net/x/d?c=42149613&l=05b2c242-7ea9-4c96-9fa1-42f00055b16a&r=66de14c3-b364-4097-8afa-48eb3add8425) ____
913-414-4446
#teamkc

I will be closing down this email, for now, so if you would like to stay in touch, please do so by using my personal email mailto:kcrnkovich@gmail.com. Thank you! This has been the ride of a lifetime and I am so grateful that you were a part of it. Best regards,__ Karen Crnkovich for Congress, KS03 __ 913-414-4446 #teamkc

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: time to hit the road
body:
Can you see the photo I’ve attached of our Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck?
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Do you see the massive truck behind our Ohio Regional Coordinator, Jamie Curry, in the photo I’ve attached?

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtyjtdd-duchtdja-y/) That’s our state-of-the-art **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** – and it’s heading off on a HUGE fall tour to Battleground States soon!

Its first stop will be in North Carolina from September 9th – 13th.

Pro-Life Friend, this mobile billboard truck is a critical part of our Election-Year Programs to EXPOSE the radicalism of pro-abortion politicians – something you and I know the media will never do.

But while we’ve found touring this truck to be highly effective at spreading our messages across the country, a truck like this can run up costs quickly.

So, in order to make the rounds with our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck,** I’ll need your help right away!

**[Can you agree to your most generous contribution to help keep our Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck on the road through November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtyjtdd-duchtdja-j/)?**

While we still use traditional billboards, we’ve found that many companies get squeamish when you start calling out their pro-abortion political pals.

Even though they’ll post insane pro-abortion billboards, like one from the Satanic Temple that says, **“ABORTIONS SAVE LIVES!”,** they still tell our team at _Students for Life Action,_ “NO.”

But as you already know Pro-Life Friend, the Pro-Life Movement wasn’t built on pro-lifers getting a fair shake.

So, we told the billboard companies to **GO POUND SAND** and got our own traveling Billboard!

And boy, has it paid off tremendously!

With our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck,** _Students for Life Action_ has been able to:

**>>>** Launch massive statewide tours reaching tens of thousands more people than a standing billboard ever could;

**>>>** Change messages quickly and easily when needed – which you can’t do with static billboards. If a pro-abortion Senator sticks a foot in his mouth a week before Election Day, we’ll be able to go to voters where they are and expose pro-abortion politicians’ records;

**>>>** Screen pro-life movies like _Unplanned_ on college campuses, which is PROVEN to convert even the most hardcore pro-abortion radicals;

**>>>** Complement our door-knocking campaigns in key communities and even on college campuses; and

**>>>** “Crash” high-profile events like Presidential debates or pro-abortion marches while we play video messages of all of the insane things pro-abortion radicals say that media elites ignore.
That's why I hope you will **[make a generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ to help us make the most of our Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck this fall](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtyjtdd-duchtdja-t/)!**

The fact is, _Students for Life Action_ has some big plans through November, including:

******* Pounding the pavement in key states like Arizona where a handful of Republicans joined Democrats in repealing the state's pro-life law; and

******* Continuing to counter _Planned Parenthood's_ lies in states ike Florida, Nebraska, and Missouri where extreme abortion amendments are being proposed.
That’s why I’m hoping that I can find some generous pro-lifers like you, **[who are willing to help me cover the cost of using our Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtyjtdd-duchtdja-i/)** before the November elections!

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – Our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** is a critical part of our Election-Year Programs to EXPOSE the radicalism of pro-abortion politicians – something you and I know the media will never do.

But while we’ve found touring this truck to be highly effective at spreading our messages across the country, a truck like this can run up costs quickly.

**[Can you agree to your most generous contribution to help keep this Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck on the road through November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gtyjtdd-duchtdja-d/)?**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.
---
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you are no longer interested you can [unsubscribe instantly](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-u-gtyjtdd-duchtdja-l/).

## Trump Campaign Hit by Foreign Hackers
The Trump campaign said some [internal documents were hacked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUxfGngY0ILhDbA0MXb-na0UL4Em7Lh2UTR337KpW6df4N5-j_cVtunjLV-7sv6Hpsiw-dTlxGoUCAWQxfXUQE1BydGkCb6wQWeHLKGhUQwA5WaT1pE6c4jDZ4NUyrjFdODiQYOSpQUlptL9ZYbQCUl1EP1gzMSFypt_3y2aj2hDF_txP3S2iFZ5d63w6m3xjMDOaeMFHOL2Mwp1aw4vNgMAdfNk_3ymA2IwBYEH1_lE38gaDaca8-i9BKeVQKvlOrh0g-fOHKYOa7W7cn5UzH9fXqXjz9LvH-f5PTwU8AAAD__6_oYwI) and blamed the leak on "foreign sources hostile to the United States." [Microsoft appeared to confirm](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1v9CAQhH8NdLZggfNdQfE2dPe2Ka2VWexN8IcwtpV_Hzl12pmRntHz8e7fyJmX8T_O5Gtaexwqn9Q_Gw0N2N7K6BMRkJHkdQfGPl7gQE5eKXqlweIrJdJoug6BbIrwQI1IGCV7UGDVU4NWyhnXOuuMBdCokumc7YRVFLmupf1ceakTpfy9nlTaYZ1l9lOt2y7MPwFBQLiuq60TjQeWyLjcGwHh2JuFrl1AwFJ5yCQg3NQ7OEYBQWsBoZZj3hqakXMz4fAli4_bxTnz_rhfjHfzS61_Ozg9_AQAAP__vVZdeQ) the campaign's accusations, saying that hackers with ties to Iran sent the emails from the compromised account of an unnamed "former senior advisor." News outlet [POLITICO confirmed the leak](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFuhDAQheHTmA40nrGBFC7SuNu0KZFjxsskBiPWWZTbR6RO_6Tv_e-36RYky3Z_Cyu7msoUYpUnT2OrsUUzmWZ2iRmZGnZ6QDL9C1psFvcx2t7OTMYG7Clo4KSZyPSceqt1bMQhoIFRowawZDtrLBlEHSDRYM2gDPAstRzdZ5GtLpzyT3ny0cWyNtktte4PRa8KvUJ_nme3lyxVYrkGCv3G50OhvxSFHkaFXoNCX4_vdW9jWPcg961dQvxqAfRAFqg53LyfkrM8-uvAfQ2S_8D6f_7T4W8AAAD__zWVWJA) after receiving emails from an anonymous account offering internal documents from the campaign, including a vetting dossier on Trump running mate JD Vance.
## 2024 Olympics Wrap-Up in Paris
The 2024 Paris Olympics ended Sunday [with closing ceremonies](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUxfGnwRsRXMB2BoYubOna0SL42rkVHxYgV377Kp07H-nop__XY3l4ipT3T5_Q9q0sPnQ6cZm5BA560cNqN0RANaCVEyg93sHA8LJBTQHmyY_baMy0yiCC8eYO8NRCoPEDWRCgxSxBCmGUuRltlAaQXmxqMnpiWuBKvdTbd6HcX7jFq5xYb6GkIdpX70dj6oOBY-BOXwn79d4YuPczA9dPBm6P5ekjA3f4So2XeKWDQuMhlkZ55wErppIvnkrC3Bs_sG6lJp8DNi5BjVIoMSsGbqh2PX4oRmrjm7cnT_GP0_-Pc1r4DQAA__9ecmU7) at the Stade de France featuring over a hundred performers, acrobats, dancers, and circus artists. When all the events ended on Sunday, the U.S. was tied with China for the most gold medals with 40 each, but [won the overall medal count,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFvgzAQBeBfYzYj-2wDGTx0YUvXjsjBR3KVwci-BOXfV1Tq1u1JT0_69L6u0zVQou3-GVb0vOQpzEwvnAapQYKdbBP9gghoGvS6B2O7CzhoHh7tZb4puMAyDNE57DqjehdmdGpWQ7QNeVBg1aBBK-WMa511xgLooBbTO9sLqzAS59J-Z9r4gUt65xeWds5rk_yDea_CfAgYBYzHcbQFn4ylnr2Ase65cBUw5vRed5rP-NyIMcrKgbFKzrtcMYZUJYdbQolblHsoVOXfRp5GqQaptYCxKT7uB6VEtTt59zVQ-uXw_-e8PPwEAAD__yJvZlY) 126 to China's 91. Prime-time Olympics coverage the past two weeks drew an average of 32 million viewers, up 79% from Tokyo three years ago. name: Monroe County Republican Committee
subject: Host a Meet and Greet for our Candidates
body:
Please consider hosting a meet and greet for our candidates. It's a simple
and a fun way to help out!
It's as easy as 1, 2, 3...

1. Set a date and time with me. We generally book evening hours such as
6:00pm-7:30pm. Saturday and Sunday day hours are fine too. It's really up
to you.
2. Invite your family and friends to come meet the candidates. We don't
care how many people come. Our goal is to get our message out and engage
with voters.
3. Have beverages and light munchies for your guests. That's up to you!

Please call me to schedule your meet and greet ASAP. We are booking for
September and October now.

Yvonne Donnelly
546-8040

## Uvalde Releases Records from School Shooting
The city of Uvalde has released [a significant collection of records](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGSpCAURb8GMyx4oEBAsIlZb7qhhfBsqcXGAlp7_n6qpyaYZNJ7T3LOv9t8czHFx_2v29G215pn51s8cdaUAwU5yy7YhQXDO7RcgZDjIIB3m9XSDMxItmjOtdIO1ChC4MaxweOI0EULDCTTHDgbRqH6deWDVNwoY4QYlSKSYYgtl75t2PDl6po-8oml93nvkt1aOyoRfwhMBKbruvr_5xPfJ4HJlRZ9QgLTA69KYKoH-ugSLXjk0t7L83QpIK1-yznRuuXc4uNOYDqeS4qeFvS5hEoLJnQV6Te_u1p_0qAHKtgaBENNl2VdqORB0AWUphAABNcG9WC6YsNxxZRiHd9u993F9KXSfil7WvgMAAD___ddees) from the May 2022 mass shooting at Robb Elementary School, including body camera footage, 911 calls, and other documents. This release, resulting from [a legal case brought by media outlets](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAURL_GdFhwwRAKite4y2u3tG7gEiOREBnWzv79yum3m2I0c3S-rssVc8nP-398kO_vVBcMPe-0XLgEDnrRLPqbiE4y8tKC0mZSINnqDV6CsBYsWRsjTC4AKnczySAmE4hlDwK0uEiQYjLKjinJSVvprHNKGWsHLSjmXrexr9TpjS2Vn7rTNob6YMWvvb_aoP4NMA8wH8cxpvrWTzraWRhgPuMA8_eOJRL_LPAW1loLb2utPT_vfM-RauNOSh6wlMY3KoSNItt8fB25lNzMiXJ_YC6f5_6HiN3DbwAAAP__StRhuQ), provides insight into the chaotic scene and the heavily criticized slow law enforcement response. The records include a 911 call from the shooter's uncle and harrowing communications from teachers inside the school. They also reveal that officers heard shots roughly 45 minutes after arriving on the scene but waited [another 30 minutes or so](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L-OhCAYBPCnwU4DH_-0oLiGbq-90rDysZKwsgFW17e_eP1V00wyv8zPbb65mOL2-HZPNO0T8uyWFnecx55BD2IWnTd36ifWoWEauFCSA-tWo0IIgi4MPdK7DhK8HpWTMii8Mz6KLhqgIOjIgFGpuB5CYFJoNulp4lxpTQRFH1suQ1ux4cfVkM68YxmW_OySWVt7VcK_CFgC9jiO4V1dy96dV4GArS2Xk4Dd8KhXuBbzRsBeuwQsHQlYRgnY9-6Sx74ua86pr2vOLW6PvuCSi699wYSuoidgtdCSMsUo1QRsV4x_HTGlWNXFfTxdTH-69s9Zu4HfAAAA__9za2nO) to confront the gunman. Some news organizations are still pursuing legal action for the release of additional records from other agencies involved in the incident.
## NASA Launches 45-Day Mars Simulation in Texas
NASA has launched a [45-day simulated Mars mission](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00D2O6yAUQOHV4A4LLgRCQfEad3ntlBYx1zYSPxEQO7P7kaef-jSfztdjfrgQQ97-u4S2f9Yyu6WHA-c75UBBznLw9sm84QNarkFIdRPAh90ahcJLJcxTC2kWyRlnEhezes6Br2oIFhhIdufA2U0JPa4rv0nNjTZGCKU1kQx96KWOfceOH9fW-F0OrONS0hDt3vurEfGPwERgOs9zzK65cSsHgWl_J5cbDZm2l1uQwHRFWrGhq8tOjxLfuSPWRnuhT9xCphk_nbaQ3tF19DSF1kLJV0-uNgLTUK1_nSHG0NTF25IL8VfT_5hzWPgJAAD__5C_aG0) involving four volunteers at Johnson Space Center in Houston. [The team consists](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2uozAUhJ8GuoN8jIG4cEFDd7fdEhl8CJb8g2wHkn36FelvNaMZafRp_v7MP9o6G55_tCdV3luc9VrsSfMDkAMXs6iNWpiRWJPCgbei71qO9a7EozdsQZI4rIw0Ld3SMYlC9ojcbKy2ijMu2AM5sq5vh2bbsBMDykHKtu2HoRKMjC0xNWWnQm-dN_eJJ6Vmjb52ai_lyFU7Vnyq-HRdV-NzuLuKTxTglSs-BbpuKbTuIbr4_NyZzhryHk_KIOCM7hUKUcpgQ4ngdcrgbc42BsjWv5wuX3volWCLCUQHRn_uWZ1gHDGO-O-okzLHZZ2zub_Jn15b9wUtv_x2Kv4_AAD__xi7cSE) of a structural engineer, an aerospace engineer, a medical director, and a navigation engineer, who will live in a 650-square-foot habitat from August 9 to September 23. Participants will engage in various tasks, including plant harvesting, shrimp growing, and simulated Mars walks using virtual reality. [Take a look at these photos](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00Luu2zAMxvGnsTcauvk2eOiS7XTtGCgWdUJUlgKRtk_evnD2Tv-NxO_783X_8pQof__2Gy7yE8vdr0IH3ifQBoy7uzYsDxVm3eKiR2Pd0Fuj2-cS1xlXa2JAXOchTm6edDS2n-w6qCE-WlqMMk5N2mjVD3bsYtS9G_U8zrO1wzg2TmEgKbWTJwr-eI7pXQ6s3Vq2Ni1PkRc39ldjbo25nefZPXamjMxSgn93lBtzO4h3n1hKJeTG3DKeV1JZ_2KAkmHzlQHzQbXkDbNALBVcD8G_GbJnD1KAMgl5QagY4JV8RgGmbU9e6LpBzFc_f-EkeYIHQb9BieDgKGnPglgZtHWTGkArUD1c_rYu4XVSSsTDJf7ePKUPUP6z97GYfwEAAP__UGmF1A). This mission is part of a series of four analog missions conducted by NASA's Human Research Program to explore the effects of Mars-like journeys on crew members' mental and physical health.
## Invasive Fish Caught In Central Texas
A fish [native to Africa](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPhCAQhX8NdhgZQNeCYhtzzV57pcFlWCdB2Air3r-_aH_VzMtXvC_v5zE-LAWKr2-7oCmHT6N9FtpwvHEBHNSoKmemxvWiQiM6kKrVEkQ1G62chqezfSugBYQJe6e1k5MV06SEqshAA6q5CRCNbmVXey-06kTf9b2Ubdcx1aCjkta6zFjwsNmH37ThWj_TUgUzl_LOTN4ZDAyGfd_rJceTMRgw8k9mMETcz3P9FDebaUPuKc_cp090nCIvM_KdguM-rVfwtObCCy144bOYwWBXfr-LdHzNU7Ua994pBMrtaflaLIVLqvyz0WbgLwAA__9pImm_) was recently caught in Central Texas, prompting the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department to warn against dumping aquarium fish in lakes and waterways. In a Friday [Facebook post](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQAL8Gd7G8C-x6C4onRe7y2istbCBGR44oRnHu70-5_vqRZjQfl_nic8lf1__-Fl17pTr7teVnnMcT4AnNbLrgliEIdNEBozZkNUK3uRWC8BKJUQsmAO_DIuAxCo6GPHTZ4YBmGAFhsKS5TwmsYRAW0ZqYlRliyK0--rbFFl9-T-W7PuOjX-utK25r7b4r_U_hpHA6jqNPfo1LrZ9vQOF032qrSk9pyUHps4AVJCFGwyORQtpjU_rse8SRB2JG0mStdA8X7kcuJe_0rrjefC6_0vbHg6fDnwAAAP__CV1Y2g), the TPWD reported a hybrid peacock cichlid was caught in the South Fork of the San Gabriel River near Leander. It's the first time the striped orange and black fish has been caught anywhere in the U.S. [Officials urge anglers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DFvhCAYxvFPgxtGQEUHhiaN23XtaBBe5U0RDHDqffvmund_kueX__djfmj0GLYvvYMq9xpnbQqeMA-Uccrbua2sWho7sgoUk1y0fSc4q5wSdujWpZNMGiO1NbJZx743nC1LN5rRVqh4w9tmYJw1XS9kva6sayUb5TgK0UtJ2gYslpjq4qDArfPqX_GEVJu4V165Uo5MxAfhE-HTdV01nJBexWHY_HNZovl5LwmfAlyZ8CkXXYAm2DAG7QmfXLyoDhTuWNDQFbOjECxY-jwoBloc0KwD3fSSEDxNeEJ6v4kp3PnQSe9EfA5VUva40HvM_Ru97Rr9n7H8k-xU_DcAAP__66VwWw) to report and keep any caught hybrid peacock cichlids, as these non-native fish can introduce diseases or become invasive predators, posing significant threats to local ecosystems.

body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zhpdhtt7dt8ubj6804p05db2gjgt4tm592cfdn4g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmapr4c5h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z3m583gf3rpra67gpedhkni0j195ev2trvuib9p0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmapr4c5h2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqq1ak6gogn959in03eag4m510dftbr8glq1i3n0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmapr4c5h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zr3d75om7ri21glfqif1kd8n6aovaql6pls2kn9o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmapr4c5h2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z58640ufeht465b8pn1nlvcjr8ic33o4mdu2qd6g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmapr4c5h2bs)_**

Thank you and may God bless you,
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqgnr606g9lhnvp9kbp2h5ml7dtp4mpd5ou071s0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmapr4c5h2bs)

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trump National Committee JFC Inc
body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn0j72q4plpr9gggvsqiga6hh95p31t9uck45em8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgo5t12k1svjlg672kqb08huf7he6qmp9501ggeg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf98aeutu45q6cgbdf1pakisluo9h1snvs3bvllo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zubig0aj527f4k4t0bvpdr7olfckqfhah2hi899g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zinn5bh7d1gt3rosh699cs63b07th9uedu7cbq98_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z84tau62n7hdsnlnd5ribt1k00fnp464qkfqp4e0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)
Thank you and may God bless you,
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9218m7o4fc5qajrhsooj6t7m1t99fua9vruohbg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z622dumcc6kg6t93pnlk7gcupqcid0hjbe40rb48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jm6or0cth2bs)
JD Vance Future Vice President of the United States
PS: If you can’t afford to donate because Kamala Harris has wrecked our economy, please save your donation for another time. I only ask that you please say a prayer for everyone currently serving in harm’s way.

**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z07jjfe507irvb9ukjhesujg2nt3d4cto4g65hug_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmepb2cjh2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zs8akkk10dmrfsjkcphtk2mkaq50no12ciuq08ng_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmepb2cjh2bs)_**

My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zamin1gumjf4203ddvt2q6rlb1e8gq3lig83bpgg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c5jmepb2cjh2bs)_**

# We Can Strive for Better...

**Peter -** Gun violence and its impact on families and communities has been seen nationwide and continues to escalate.

While ideas about how to fix the problem vary across party lines, we can all agree that the safety of our children and communities is paramount. No one should have to send their children to school worrying that their child may be the latest victim in a school shooting event. No one should be afraid to attend public events due to the rising accounts of violence.

We can strive for better in our nation.

We can make sure that our rights are protected by also ensuring that our communities are safe. Common-sense gun legislation and reform are just that - a part of confronting a problem while not punishing responsible gun owners.

Those convicted of domestic violence or other violent charges should not be able to easily access firearms.

Those with severe and untreated mental illness should not be able to exploit loopholes and obtain weapons with the intent to harm.

Unfortunately, we live in a world where people use their second amendment right to harm others, and we cannot allow it to continue and target more and more of our children.

**Peter, we can do better and bring forward more nuanced and effective policies to combat gun violence in our nation.**[**Help to bring a voice to Washington that understands the importance of this issue and the many ideas that shape it by chipping in today.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=fd4c5b6562&e=a2a46ff12c)

subject: Fewer than 90 days until Election Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Hi friend, it's Kirsten. I have an important update for you: **We have fewer than 90 days until Election Day. **
This means we’re closer to protecting our Senate majority, the White House and, ultimately, our democracy. But I won’t lie to you, friend: The stakes have never been higher.
What happens on Election Day will determine the fate of our nation. And with the GOP continuing to attack our personal freedoms, it remains absolutely critical for us to do everything we can to defend our Senate majority from right-wing extremism.

That's why I’m fighting in the Senate so we can certify the Equal Rights Amendment and restore reproductive rights nationwide, protect and expand Social Security and Medicare, prevent gun violence and keep our communities safe, lower the cost of living and win meaningful change for hardworking families in New York and across the United States.
But here's the bad news, friend: Republicans had historic victories in New York in 2022, and now, they're targeting my seat for defeat.

**I'm a strong believer that grassroots activism matters. I know that campaigns are won by the people who put in the work, big or small — from volunteers knocking on doors and stuffing envelopes to supporters turning out the vote and donating when you can. subject: Week one. I can’t do this without you.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1756%2E135344%2E1hhjhQ)

Friend -
First and foremost, I want to thank you for your support in advance of last week's U.S. Senate primary in Michigan. It is an honor to be the Democratic nominee for Senate. I will work as hard as I ever have for anything in order to win this November.
Now the sprint is on to the general election, where we'll face Republican Mike Rogers.
This is going to be one of the most expensive and competitive races in the country, the polls show it starts off extremely close, and I won't be able to win this alone. So, today, I am asking for your support to get us off on the right foot:
[**Are you able to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? We're looking for lots of donations on this first week of the general election. Use this link to give.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240812-1-900&t=2&akid=1756%2E135344%2E1hhjhQ)
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240812-1-900&t=3&akid=1756%2E135344%2E1hhjhQ)**
So, who is Mike Rogers, the Republican who won the GOP nomination?
First, he was Trump's endorsed candidate in the Republican primary.
He was on the Trump national security transition team before 2017, and was in talks to be Trump’s Director of FBI, but then got removed from Trump’s team. Then he became a critic of Trump, even going so far as to call him “more gangster than presidential,” became a commentator for CNN, and even considered a run for President against him.
Then, in a truly stunning about-face, he changed his tune in order to gain Trump's favor in this Senate race. And it worked. He’s been kissing the Trump ring ever since.
But there's much more beyond Trump:
He has supported an extreme nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions for rape, incest, or common miscarriage; he authored 4 bills that would ban IVF; he voted to cut and privatize Social Security and Medicare. He represented a version of my current congressional district, 4 years before I flipped it – but with a different set of values.
Not only does this one race have the possibility of determining control of the Senate, but it is a microcosm of which direction the Senate will take as a whole depending on who wins.
Like I said, this race will be incredibly expensive and competitive. All the polls are tight, and how we start this general election may determine how it ends. So I am asking:
[**Can you please contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan? We're looking for a large number of donations on the first week of this general election.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240812-1-900&t=4&akid=1756%2E135344%2E1hhjhQ)

#
Dear Friend of Life,

As you read this, pro-life Americans are sitting in prison.

It is a travesty that, in our nation's capital, the abortionists who slaughter nearly full-term infants walk free while peaceful pro-life activists who protest their gruesome butchery are thrown into prison.Here are just some of the names of pro-life people jailed for standing against abortion.
* Lauren Handy, a 30-year-old pro-life activist, was sentenced to 57 months, more than four years.
* Joan Andrews Bell, a 76-year-old grandmother who has dedicated her life to saving babies and women from abortion, was sentenced to 27 months in prison.
* Jean Marshall, 74, was sentenced to 24 months in prison.
* John Hinshaw, a 69-year-old pro-life activist, was sentenced to 21 months.
* Iraq War veteran Jonathan Darnel faces 34 months in prison.

These pro-lifers were found guilty of violating the Freedom of Access to Clinic Entrances (FACE) Act -- a law that the Biden administration is weaponizing to jail pro-life Americans who peacefully protest at abortion facilities.

They weren't engaged in "hate." They were motivated by love.

You and I both know that free speech is the cornerstone of our liberty. No American should be silenced, whether pro-life or pro-abortion. Sadly, this basic understanding of democracy is missing at the DOJ, which is why we must fight back before it is too late and more pro-life people are sent to prison.

**That 's why my team released a petition demanding Congress repeal the FACE Act** so that Biden's DOJ can no longer use it as a cover for their anti-free speech agenda. We need to reach the millions of pro-life people at risk so they can respond. But we can't do that without you.

**Your gift of $50 right now will help us alert thousands more people about the DOJ 's actions so they can join the fight to repeal the FACE Act.** It will also ensure that our breaking news articles and cutting-edge video and media content can change minds about abortion and save lives.

We are looking for 49 more people to give before midnight, can you be one of them? [**Here 's a secure link to where you can make your gift and fight back. https://give.liveaction.org/urge-congress-to-repeal-the-face-act/**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

Thank you for standing up for preborn children and against this horrific injustice.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7233%2E5257348%2ErVcon0 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —

Growing up, I was deeply inspired by my parents, and they taught me many
life lessons.

To respect others. To try to step into their shoes. To listen and learn
and pay attention in school. To make the world a better place.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em.nPj3QZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240812_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7233%2E5257348%2ErVcon0 ]Throwback photo of Adam with his parents and brother

Both of my parents shared these values with my brother, Dan, and me — but
they didn’t share a political affiliation.

My mom, Sherry, came from a long line of Republicans. Her father, my
grandfather, was a Republican County chairman who greeted President Dwight
Eisenhower and Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. when Ike was campaigning for
reelection in 1954.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em.nPj3QZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240812_AM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=7233%2E5257348%2ErVcon0 ]On the left, a photo of Adam's mom Sherry. On the right, a photo of
Adam's grandfather with President Eisenhower

On the left, my mom. On the right, my grandfather with President
Eisenhower.

Growing up, there were plenty of political debates in our household. My
brother adopted my mom’s Republicanism. I became a Democrat like my dad.
But the conversation was never acrimonious.

Back then, Democrats and Republicans could disagree without being
disagreeable. But that has changed, thanks in large part to Donald Trump,
who insults and attacks anyone who disagrees with him.

I’ve worked with plenty of Republican members of Congress to make
meaningful progress on important issues like mass transit, national
security, open space, nuclear nonproliferation, freedom of the press, and
more.

But these days, far too many of my colleagues in the GOP are siding with
Donald Trump and unwilling to work for the greater good of our country and
our democracy.

They stand strongly alongside Trump, even when he breaks the law, or
incites a violent attack against the Capitol — or, with the help of a
partisan Supreme Court, aspires to place himself above the law.

The list of his enablers includes my opponent, Steve Garvey, who just
announced he will be voting for Trump again.

Derek, this is
not my mother’s Republican Party. And we need to defeat Donald Trump
before he fundamentally changes the country for the worse — and forever.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2024_abs_em.nPj3QZ&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240812_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=7233%2E5257348%2ErVcon0 ]With your support, we will reject Trump this fall and send a resounding
message that his brand of politics is not what this country wants or
needs. Please, chip in to help me defeat Trump AND Trumpism this November.

donation will go through immediately:

A string of endless wars has hollowed out America’s treasury, soulless multinational corporations have hollowed out America’s economy, and an insidious, woke-minded virus has hollowed out America’s soul. We are the last line of defense for—America’s future.

When you look back years from now and you tell the story of this time to your children, your grandchildren, your nieces and nephews, in a time of consequence and in a time that mattered - what will you tell them? That you watched helplessly as America crumbled, or that you took a stand for your country in a time when our choices could shape the direction of this country?

The choices we make right now will shape the direction of our nation for years to come. This is the moment when our choices will determine whether we have a country for years to come.

You’ll hear the left say, “Oh we need more solutions in Washington D.C.” The truth is simple— there aren't solutions in Washington D.C. The solutions for our country and the hope for our country are right in Missouri. The courage, the boldness, and the goodness are right here in Missouri.

We’ve got to work for it. We cannot get complacent — Kari Lake and Donald Trump would love it for us to take a state like Arizona for granted. Just because we’ve won the last few elections here does not mean Arizona is locked down, and the polls show it.
#

Peter,
Our rally on Friday was the biggest crowd I’ve ever seen in Arizona.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240812-1-90&t=1&akid=2852%2E734936%2EO2L3os)
Even just a few years ago this kind of thing was unheard of. Deep, deep red Arizona never went our way. It was a safe Republican state. Now, it isn’t just competitive — we’re winning here.
But those wins... they’re not easy. Every election comes down to just a few thousand votes, and Arizona is one of the toughest states in the country.
We’ve got to work for it. We cannot get complacent — Kari Lake and Donald Trump would love it for us to take a state like Arizona for granted. Just because we’ve won the last few elections here does not mean Arizona is locked down, and the polls show it. This race is a dead heat, neck-and-neck.
Back in 2022, Kari Lake lost her last election by less than 1% of all votes cast. In 2020, Trump lost by a similar margin. They’ve both learned a thing or two right now, and we can’t underestimate them.
To win, we need to out-work them. Out-vote them. And out-raise them. So, if you understand how important Arizona is and how much it’s going to take to get the job done, I’m humbly asking you:

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter,

You may have heard that there’s a “Debate About Debates” going on in
Missouri.

But last week, after Josh Hawley’s campaign reserved $1 MILLION in TV ads
to air false attacks against me, the truth behind the fake “debate” he
challenged me to was exposed, as was the total brokenness of our politics.

Please let me explain.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66345?refcode=em20240812-7320&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=7320%2E614464%2EN8Yyqy ]FIGHT BACK NOW

First, where things stand...

I believe ALL Missourians should get to hear from us. So because Hawley
immediately accepted invitations for media-moderated and hosted TV debates
in 2018, I thought — despite our disagreements — that Josh and I would at
least agree on this. I was wrong:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66345?refcode=em20240812-7320&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=7320%2E614464%2EN8Yyqy ]on the left: tweets from Josh Hawley in 2018 accepting and asking for
debates with Claire McCaskill. On the right: headlines that say Kunce
quickly agress to accept offer for a statewide debate next week and a
tweet from Lucas saying he's all in for a Fox News debate

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66345?refcode=em20240812-7320&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=7320%2E614464%2EN8Yyqy ]FIGHT BACK NOW

How’d we get here? Well let me tell you...

In recent weeks, we launched TV ads to introduce me and my message to
voters across Missouri. About the people who supported me growing up, my
service, and my mission in this Senate race. No attacks. Just me. Like
this one:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/66345?refcode=em20240812-7320&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=7320%2E614464%2EN8Yyqy ]thumbnail of Lucas' new ad

Then a supporter got polled...

The poll was filled with entirely false and ludicrous attacks against me,
clearly Hawley and his allies testing TV ads to run against me. It was a
sign our message is resonating and that Hawley’s public nervousness was
genuine:

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Over 150 Anti-Israel, Pro-Communist Groups Join Nationwide Coalition to March During DNC Convention in Chicago Next Week (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/over-150-anti-israel-pro-communist-groups-join-nationwide-coalition-to-march-during-dnc-convention-in-chicago-next-week.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=08d38dfb8d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Anti-American, anti-Israeli protesters burn the American flag in Washington, DC on July 24, 2024. (Matthew Hatcher / AFP via Getty Images)
By Illinois Review

The City of Chicago and Democratic National Committee officials are expecting mass protests next week during the convention, as more than 150 groups have formed a nationwide coalition to march down city streets leading to the United Center – the site where delegates are expected to officially nominate Vice President Kamala Harris as their Democratic nominee for president.

The nationwide coalition expected to march in Chicago next week includes groups like Black Lives Matter Chicago, Freedom Socialist Party, Denver Communists, Palestinian Assembly for Liberation, Democratic Socialists of America, Milwaukee for Yemen and National Students for Justice in Palestine. The groups represent the new voice of the Democratic party, and have left traditional Democrats who remain pro-police, pro-Israel, pro-law and order and pro-America, feeling alienated and marginalized.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/08/over-150-anti-israel-pro-communist-groups-join-nationwide-coalition-to-march-during-dnc-convention-in-chicago-next-week.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=08d38dfb8d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
It’s estimated that over 13 million illegals have crossed into the U.S. from our southern border since the Biden-Harris administration took over in 2020 – placing an enormous burden and financial strain on communities left to figure out how to address the migrant crisis that’s taking over their towns and villages. In March of 2021, Biden made Harris the “border czar” tasked with addressing the migrant crisis. Harris welcomed the new assignment, saying at the time, “Needless to say, the work will not be easy, but it is important work.”

Many of the groups expected to march during the DNC next week are demanding that the Biden-Harris regime call on Israel for an immediate ceasefire and for the U.S. military to end sending aid to Israel. On the coalition’s website, it reads in bold letters,
“The march on the DNC will be a march for Palestine!”

I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ac357fb48003468284792cd7ea09bd03&_e=feWWWxtUzzHUKHzS-iOkZh6wkqO9ZtTk7GlL7HJbHvxlvQ5uvf1qIMuP4-NmbfaSXH0NGtmV8mUtC_d7eUJQgU9_oNB1TfTr54hw1iIScUOyUB2GLC7UyuW1s7vXgR1MolIQTJjKxukdvAQiz1ejK6Vfq0RhGGxiRLdm8BmF3EGNFmlvoc_drJwx5x9Euj7sCL8Lzfr6KtWZOC5taHONEty9PRmvgMx-w4VUyFVpsPY0p_rok2bYoX5zklaYGXdLQOD8ljjsSS6FGGLGN3bh2SojecCQllga4PyQOBhLvs78QaF_zaAJ8-4QHxg4ItBP)

|

Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our "leaders" in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn't know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ac357fb48003468284792cd7ea09bd03&_e=feWWWxtUzzHUKHzS-iOkZh6wkqO9ZtTk7GlL7HJbHvxlvQ5uvf1qIMuP4-NmbfaSXH0NGtmV8mUtC_d7eUJQgU9_oNB1TfTr54hw1iIScUOyUB2GLC7UyuW1s7vXgR1MolIQTJjKxukdvAQiz1ejK6Vfq0RhGGxiRLdm8BmF3EGbr66D_m_OO2Pqpl7d3tradZOn6S97BE-A6m3_9XDbdaCYF95kgzg3SstrmO1gzx1hUGuu15DsanPM7dyc3YumwNPpmEO5GThFX0CnLo7AUjcnmzr4uDU44iLkrisVotIbjcZnRdmRALlQf8F_q9TE)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I'm proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn't like you'd see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That 's what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we're going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.

## Energy for Alaska

Dear Friends,

As I travel across our great state, I’m reminded every day of the immense energy it takes to connect with each of you, hear your concerns, and work towards the future we all envision for Alaska. Whether it’s the miles traveled, the conversations had, or the plans we’re putting in motion, energy is at the core of everything we do.

But the energy I’m talking about doesn’t just come from within—it comes from the incredible natural resources our state is blessed with. Alaska’s vast reserves of oil, gas, and renewable energy sources are the lifeblood of our economy and the key to securing a prosperous future. I’m committed to fighting for responsible development of these resources, ensuring that Alaskans benefit from the wealth beneath our feet while protecting the natural beauty we all cherish.

As your next Congressman, I’ll bring the same energy to Washington, D.C., to get things done for Alaska.

But here’s the critical point: energy alone isn’t enough—we need seniority. At 46, I’m the only candidate in this race with the runway to build the seniority Alaska needs in Congress. This seniority is crucial to navigating the complexities of D.C. politics and making sure Alaska’s voice is not just heard, but respected and acted upon. The first step is winning this upcoming primary on August 20th, and I need your help to make it happen. You can vote early or in person on Election Day. Head over to [elections.alaska.gov/avo](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=9d9c8a6126&e=6679001ba0) for more information on early voting locations and times. Every vote counts, and your support is essential to securing a brighter future for Alaska. Together, we can channel the energy of our state and its people to secure a future that honors our traditions, protects our resources, and ensures prosperity for generations to come. I’m asking for your support because this is a long-term fight, and with your help, we can achieve great things.
Thank you for standing with me. Let’s keep the energy up—there’s so much more to do!

**America First, Fighting for Alaska!**

Best regards,

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress

Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.
I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith.
Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat.
I made the decision to run again because I knew I could count on people like you to help me win, so it would mean so much to me if you could chip in to my campaign today:

clean_body: After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make. Hello, After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make. When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits. Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children. After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last. I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith. Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat. body:
We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LTO-5PF-Sh63Gmtkb5xrYuuwDHzzCfTYqe6E0kMr5rclztB6hscazfusXOGe-KmmhfrHDTQahA8MCT7nFQ6xUlDFJM3wfkU0ivhvXHZgevtQz59mliCvsvjAn10T5kUwRPBaR_qceVEaiM6zuvaO-gYoPTaPXmrQj8VEP1_zMy9Kg%3D%3D)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LSeedmVLGJcKtCi2NP0v3q_ZK74rsjuhBgIDZxN8q7FGNNOaFii6nXzf_AzWNLPKGKES2HYxMYG2VBCjopOSjkzNZNChgymcP5tGuGIlcnWDdgTO1Rj1mQJpxACIOgvAVh67HdNx9RAz2wtwiGtl1lkVobxfwiWXJQ3dcQe2DZSIA%3D%3D)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LSL1qhgH_1xiEb4akT8S2DpUSGqDRmDMKCv1bQxSXx-tzP1-oAqWPb1GOPm4qfF66TwrKvuCPV6L0N3gLx6TdyrEZGU-_Aek1vKq5abCnpezLuq_Vaxg2Je20TCVjTcYg62FmRQSpgFFYCO8hn7U_u9H8VgZsn1oZlleUh2MT6Cig%3D%3D)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LQ1ip9v1rDgRDq0Fog1y4xdoya0JefzpI8QUIiAPIkrd8oeQ9HXkwRQo5fr9gNsOk9Py6i_4WwtXNMg_UJZuMQTclhDVY_EEFAfU7kpqSzPkn5nqu7GHafsXR0ObAw89EcatuFO3mGxUo0zMCQ3E_vvEGs3CW_BtxJxOHXdkL8JlQ%3D%3D)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LTwkWb59XrOd9dhYSTgPu43p_g9zT3sV7Ky0Nmxen9rl1iiaouyss_XCeoLLTItE_lxJhAa56QtfWsp0yexoAPKsBhtC8A3xaYgAsnnFg_AkaC4mBNIMzX276EOuf9q24u3Sd1euYVQOro0W9tINVxTC5f6HPeO7J8euIpVo148kA%3D%3D)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LQRnLpBEUrsUx9ecw19rAhdNZq-v6Rx-gboteTDQvJ2RxoXImdfIYSMxVfNjoBo94FS2MDKPDRE0y_-Seqfv-EpRa5sQG5lQiGFunwKmVqaPbSY1-EV-p50mzz0jIVfcIMCkvOduUSh3UCPG6LxcjDmtHe_5y8dVqyktcAFw8NvMg%3D%3D)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LRQWVkCxQeO7tY6g395DEuRhn9QGaII5_7_S3_2hTcXrdPETreuCvMuJuq5k1W6oRH424ixyMR6MTk5W1y1spUn5xuMFqxFibeTxpoKNx21onEQn7aydhokkz65nuvcGnwmFaPTW_6qulnTp64w4ELSaqX08YCxWEW2Z2fD6O0GcQ%3D%3D)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=1b68d1f3d04143dba722d516997ad135&_e=4WnjxovqzlikyUHho0ZOIuiiDwjiLcQj2trkkCLw_46z9f3mbGYs9QkqZUHk9XWOYxTQlMO5hv46I3IYzWKpmeM-Bahcs4MLmRRLQpx2EyjZpkxLSo6N7Nmmjf5p63cmdAzU5neUr1IUjwgYnYVGugnBg9xduqsRE5jx7KIcrRymM781bjUWaZ0lEEynKrxVQHz6PFZpWo26YACKPn2XvNK6JJvqPVelotYFpAuc6LTwxHwWVdWVKSKTPPHSYz_W1isezER2XiHsWFO_zOX7MvtZXq6TIrv8FLmUdUPXXhu9-dk1eQv3ygh7Pa9_cyt2BBJsPeOM6hBFCLJwdh9Q5fvRdZfVZtpHfrd-SJWusyq5hCc5YqdSflaGB2d4cXo8QOkgAe75FGmNyQ2nD1cxfQ%3D%3D "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign. But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place. | That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children. | I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf. After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve. | Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them. Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first. | So, I once again decided to stop complaining and actually do something about it. body:
I promise I won't do this every week

Friend —
I promise I won't do this every week, but I did want to encourage you to listen to the latest episode of my podcast, Politickin', with Marhsawn Lynch and Doug Hendrickson.
The guest is someone you all know and love — Jimmy Kimmel.
[**Here's a direct link to the podcast, along with a little video preview below.**](https://podcasts.apple.com/ca/podcast/politickin-with-gavin-newsom-marshawn-lynch-and/id1755262381?refcode=em240812-1-subs)
[](https://podcasts.apple.com/ca/podcast/politickin-with-gavin-newsom-marshawn-lynch-and/id1755262381?refcode=em240812-1-subs)
[LISTEN TO THE PODCAST](https://podcasts.apple.com/ca/podcast/politickin-with-gavin-newsom-marshawn-lynch-and/id1755262381?source=em240812-1-subs)
We talked about his time hosting the Oscars and why he isn't doing it again.
We talked about the future of late night talk shows as well as his friendship with other late hosts compared to the older days of the genre.
We also had a very interesting conversation about homelessness that goes beyond the talking points — I think you'll get a lot from that.
And stay tuned for the story about Jimmy bringing a briefcase on his first day of 7th grade as well as my discovery of hair gel in high school...
Sounds good?
[**It would mean a lot to me if you'd give the podcast episode a listen or save it for later. You can get it at this link.**](https://podcasts.apple.com/ca/podcast/politickin-with-gavin-newsom-marshawn-lynch-and/id1755262381?source=em240812-1-subs)

Gavin Newsom

name: Bernie Sanders
subject: Asking you contribute $3 to stand with Ilhan Omar today
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
As our movement's struggle continues, I know that we can count on Ilhan not to back down from the fight — because Ilhan has never backed down before.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)

Friends, it's Bernie Sanders.
I'm reaching out to ask you to make a contribution to Ilhan Omar's re-election campaign for Congress before her primary in Minnesota tomorrow. If that's all you need to hear, please donate directly to her campaign using this link:
**[https://act.ilhanomar.com/ilhan-and-bernie](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug24.QjfTG2&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=2&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
Otherwise, let me tell you a bit about the Ilhan that I know.
Ilhan is not only one of the most outstanding and courageous representatives we have in Congress today, **Ilhan is also one of the toughest people that I know.**
A few years ago during my campaign for president, Ilhan and I, along with her daughter and a handful of other progressives, met for dinner in Washington.
It was there that we heard news that Donald Trump had waged a vicious and disgusting personal attack against Ilhan, leading thousands of people at his rally to chant "send her back."
To my surprise, Ilhan was almost entirely unfazed.
Unfortunately, she told me, that kind of racism and bigotry was nothing new. "I've gotten this my whole life," she said.
Ilhan understood that Trump is a demagogue, doing what he does best: attempting to divide us up through hate. Both before and since that night, Ilhan has fought back time and again against the right wing's endless attacks and dangerous rhetoric, all while serving as a tireless champion for our nationwide movement.
So yes. Ilhan is tough. She is a leader with incredible strength and courage, and the people of Minnesota's 5th district should be enormously proud to have her fighting for our values in Washington.
That is why — with a primary election tomorrow and powerful special interest groups pouring dark money into Minnesota to try and defeat her — I'm asking you today to do something important. Something that will help ensure she stays with us in Congress for a long time to come:
**[Please use this link to make a contribution of $3 or any amount to join me in supporting Ilhan Omar's re-election campaign. At a time when progressive voices are needed more than ever, we must elect leaders like Ilhan who understand the needs of working people.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug24.QjfTG2&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=3&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
_If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your contribution will go through immediately:_
| | **[Donate $3](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/14?c0=io-em-aug24.Of-f20&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=22&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
---
****
| **[Donate $25](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/15?c0=io-em-aug24.XibOXA&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=23&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $50](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/8?c0=io-em-aug24.UX98sz&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=24&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
---
****
| **[Donate $100](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/9?c0=io-em-aug24.TQu4Dv&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=25&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $250](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/10?c0=io-em-aug24.dXviQy&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=26&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/13?c0=io-em-aug24.d7QtIf&refcode=em240812-2-subs&t=27&akid=1312%2E791427%2EHGgzFA)**
---
****
Let me very clear:
If we are serious about building a political revolution — about fighting for an agenda based on economic justice, social justice, racial justice, and environmental justice, both here in the United States and around the world — we need people like Ilhan representing those values and working for them every day in Congress.
Whether she's taking on corporate polluters and the pharmaceutical industry, or fighting for Medicare for All, canceling student debt, or an end to child hunger, I have seen firsthand the passion and commitment Ilhan brings when serving her constituents and the working people of our country.
As our movement's struggle continues, I know that we can count on Ilhan not to back down from the fight — because Ilhan has never backed down before.
Thank you for reading, and thank you for contributing to her campaign before tomorrow's primary if you can.
In solidarity,
Bernie Sanders
