Peter, Last week marked 59 years since President Lyndon B. Johnson signed the _Voting Rights Act of 1965_ , landmark legislation that secured the fundamental right to vote for so many by banning racial discrimination at the ballot box and giving the federal government the necessary tools to guarantee the right to vote for all Americans. **But now, more than a half-century later, the extreme right’s attacks on our democracy include a renewed effort to chip away at the _VRA_ while using bogus, pretextual arguments of “voter fraud” to restrict the right to vote for too many.** Republicans know that their message of fear, division, and hate loses every time to Democrats’ message of freedom, joy and results. So Republicans’ path to victory not only includes an unfair electoral college advantage but also efforts by state legislatures around the country to make it more difficult for traditionally Democratic voters to access the ballot. If Donald Trump becomes president again, and the Republicans control the House and the Senate, you can be sure that they will upend the _VRA_ entirely and gain more unfair advantages by trying to prevent access to the ballot. Democrats, on the other hand, simply want to make it easy for every American to exercise their fundamental right to vote – the foundation of our great democracy – without regard to which party one might support. If Vice President Harris becomes president, and Democrats control the House and the Senate, Democrats will immediately move forward with the _For the People Act_ , which would expand voting rights, reform campaign finance rules, ban partisan gerrymandering, among other pro-democracy provisions. The contrast is crystal clear: Republicans want our government to be ruled by the wealthy few, while Democrats want our government to be determined by every American. This November, our democracy is on the ballot. clean_body: | Peter, Last week marked 59 years since President Lyndon B. Johnson signed the Voting Rights Act of 1965 , landmark legislation that secured the fundamental right to vote for so many by banning racial discrimination at the ballot box and giving the federal government the necessary tools to guarantee the right to vote for all Americans. But now, more than a half-century later, the extreme right’s attacks on our democracy include a renewed effort to chip away at the VRA while using bogus, pretextual arguments of “voter fraud” to restrict the right to vote for too many. Republicans know that their message of fear, division, and hate loses every time to Democrats’ message of freedom, joy and results. So Republicans’ path to victory not only includes an unfair electoral college advantage but also efforts by state legislatures around the country to make it more difficult for traditionally Democratic voters to access the ballot. If Donald Trump becomes president again, and the Republicans control the House and the Senate, you can be sure that they will upend the VRA entirely and gain more unfair advantages by trying to prevent access to the ballot. Democrats, on the other hand, simply want to make it easy for every American to exercise their fundamental right to vote – the foundation of our great democracy – without regard to which party one might support. If Vice President Harris becomes president, and Democrats control the House and the Senate, Democrats will immediately move forward with the For the People Act , which would expand voting rights, reform campaign finance rules, ban partisan gerrymandering, among other pro-democracy provisions. The contrast is crystal clear: Republicans want our government to be ruled by the wealthy few, while Democrats want our government to be determined by every American. This November, our democracy is on the ballot. Republicans, Just taking a moment to remind you to vote **Tomorrow, Tuesday, August 13th on ROW B for Dr. Michael Goldstein.**
**We are the People 's Candidate as we have been out there getting to you and meeting you where YOU are.** It has been about **Family**. My family has gotten closer on this journey. It is all about **Faith** as well. And it about our **Country** and saving it.
They say a primary is about getting all the "hard" Republicans out to vote. _**I say a primary is all about the people getting out and picking the candidate they want to represent them if given a chance to get to know the candidate.**_ We have met so many first time voters and they are going out to vote and going out for Goldstein.
Yesterday we knocked over 260 doors and it is the stories about the the high energy costs and groceries that seem to be the big issues that I want to address and have been talking about solutions that we can achieve.
**Republican Motherhood is alive and well watching a mother taking a chainsaw to a tree that fell on the driveway.**
This has been a "_**Rocky Moment**_ " and _**ROW** **B**_ is all about those who are willing to fight to get on the ballot and earn your vote at the Polls.
You have been on this journey and **NOW it is** _**Your turn to Fight**_. **ON TUESDAY, August 13 - Make your Voices Heard and know I am fighting this for you, your children and the future.**

body:
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m the Democrats #1 target.

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f8986d0739a944f9ad9f4485a45253cb&_e=B89BYKLQ85zApIijNu-RNj1LTWixX44LjZs9nSEdu1Br0CXx2zg6HD02ScfHMwTSUfACbsryckPg8Qp-MgkglA93jziEmelnrZ8FQaTBKNyCjNKApxjbB7CqxrtdR0vYNKGclF10pud0u8B2aF0gWrPpA4cFlTHnozEUhr7e-B5XZPVOCl9yFOAPJyZcQCySVkGznDvfBNbzXc0EBkfFjbNUPoYdHRwr6VeSa9kKI-6S0ewBj4pxJ274gi9DAku7dmq_9-d-MAz34a8p8eaXFZ-94TNzWBxa-wK8eVEZ2RoCkUa4K48v0TLnl8C53fwC0qxsOKPzun5wtKM4ijdBcHyqIEvLsFqT9B3dCg-buK6veJycTCJhAAr8BcB8J1SG7o43vQ0iwexzHJC8mST5fg%3D%3D)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f8986d0739a944f9ad9f4485a45253cb&_e=B89BYKLQ85zApIijNu-RNj1LTWixX44LjZs9nSEdu1Br0CXx2zg6HD02ScfHMwTSUfACbsryckPg8Qp-MgkglA93jziEmelnrZ8FQaTBKNyCjNKApxjbB7CqxrtdR0vYNKGclF10pud0u8B2aF0gWrPpA4cFlTHnozEUhr7e-B5XZPVOCl9yFOAPJyZcQCySVkGznDvfBNbzXc0EBkfFjbNUPoYdHRwr6VeSa9kKI-6S0ewBj4pxJ274gi9DAku7Ge734miE-7L6csOAZSry68Pws_w-d1MtwlVXAFhhb_ct60DNpC3iluL7_belCFlkAXkyhkgRCN6oAnYtLVwA5TDtR8qjILdxhFxiyeYfK48w3hhF4fTgj54RuT2XjAM_AO1GPYbKuMD2dApCB_eKLg%3D%3D)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f8986d0739a944f9ad9f4485a45253cb&_e=B89BYKLQ85zApIijNu-RNj1LTWixX44LjZs9nSEdu1Br0CXx2zg6HD02ScfHMwTSUfACbsryckPg8Qp-MgkglA93jziEmelnrZ8FQaTBKNyCjNKApxjbB7CqxrtdR0vYNKGclF10pud0u8B2aF0gWrPpA4cFlTHnozEUhr7e-B5XZPVOCl9yFOAPJyZcQCySVkGznDvfBNbzXc0EBkfFjbNUPoYdHRwr6VeSa9kKI-6S0ewBj4pxJ274gi9DAku7prmAWYQjYAix3guch6jZFjD6Iwq7_tTuUq8l4GPYrkvVVpu2LHpLi1II3XCYKRxgoCZ22ZERggj3fNlE1ZGol5Do4l2Y2c6tduT_7ZPbh4sS6RG1g840xzIX_L3WARbLWSj1GofG-1jpjjQvpCgEaw%3D%3D)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=f8986d0739a944f9ad9f4485a45253cb&_e=B89BYKLQ85zApIijNu-RNj1LTWixX44LjZs9nSEdu1Br0CXx2zg6HD02ScfHMwTSUfACbsryckPg8Qp-MgkglA93jziEmelnrZ8FQaTBKNyCjNKApxjbB7CqxrtdR0vYNKGclF10pud0u8B2aF0gWrPpA4cFlTHnozEUhr7e-B5XZPVOCl9yFOAPJyZcQCySVkGznDvfBNbzXc0EBkfFjbNUPoYdHRwr6VeSa9kKI-6S0ewBj4pxJ274gi9DAku7uFd_v_Gi2iNX3H4BiSLqhbEYJvIveV3gDGZlX6_xEamg1mldWcb0scYswRxK3j9u5l8EZwDh5cZ-p-0Htt31Jh2JPFIHVp38hhi2Wbp1mRg9HFjaiSSCSMYGNvWyX2PAd4d6OCnea8zwK7Zgcb6R1Q%3D%3D)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---

We can’t afford 4 more years of endless war, empire and oligarchy

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_policy_from_kamala&n=1)
---
Peter,
It’s been over three weeks since Joe Biden withdrew from the race and Kamala Harris emerged as his hand-picked successor for the anti-Democratic Party’s nominee for President of the United States. In that time we’ve seen plenty of messaging on good vibes, brat summer, and cheerful coconut tree emojis swearing fealty to Kamala’s run. But a quick glance of Kamala’s website reveals what we haven’t seen – **_not a single policy position is listed._**
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_policy_from_kamala&n=2)
---
Of course, we can glean certain aspects on how Kamala Harris plans to govern based not upon the positions she’s articulated, but instead on the positions she’s walked back since her 2020 run. She’s made clear that she no longer supports Medicare For All despite 68 million Americans dying needlessly every year due to lack of coverage. She no longer supports a fracking ban as the planet burns. Without saying a single word, Kamala assures the billionaire class that she’s all about maintaining the deadly status quo. As for the ongoing genocide in Gaza, now in its 10th horrific month, Kamala has at times struck a softer, more sympathetic tone than Biden when it comes to the plight of the Palestinian people. But her mask fell off last Wednesday when she was confronted by protesters righteously chanting “We won’t vote for genocide!” and she callously replied **_“If you want Donald Trump to win, then say that. Otherwise, I’m speaking!”_** Having been shaken by the bad publicity that outburst inspired, two days later at an Arizona rally, she tried to reassure protesters that she’s been “working around the clock” for a ceasefire. But her words ring empty for the people of Gaza. The Biden-Harris administration approved yet another 3 billion dollar arms transfer to Israel just days ago and on Saturday morning, Israel unleashed three 2,000 bombs upon refugees in a school where they were sheltering. At least 100 innocent souls were massacred during their morning prayers.

**The genocide must stop now!** At any time during the past 10 months, the Biden-Harris administration has had the power to end this with a single phone call. Instead the money and arms flow freely to Israel, and they’ve been given the go-ahead to escalate with impunity.

[**_We_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_policy_from_kamala&n=3)[** _can’t afford another four years of endless war, empire and oligarchy that Kamala Harris is offering. Jill Stein is the only anti-genocide, pro-worker, pro-planet candidate with a path to the White House this November. Can you donate now to make sure the dirty duopoly can’t silence her message to millions of voters who share her values?_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_policy_from_kamala&n=4)

subject: I was attacked for being a black conservative
body:
Help students like me hear the truth... | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_s=07a712003160441bb61e8f6e4024bca2&_t=2rIDzuX28ClclpmSnjdB8ew8jSZ4mLXWfNe3cqqzxoYov4hS--kk8mth-ZuXBOV8pbCaUosaiykega2-8uKO0AUYQzXTrArVWKEwiiF59IwfKGe2byCdr32Sy5raw6p8)_
---
[](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=07a712003160441bb61e8f6e4024bca2&_e=JJjYiIPVPLBdRXWbnrAdbiLjtJonvSKm8cczXV0SzYAfKSbyKtsR-NbBZGzhna4SEoc0vNqra6vHThaby9E18nHHPITdTxZm1E9Nt-AkMArhzjnJV2HprA9ncTN6oL69FWkNUxP3XdZ-kajOTKvqpdqhRzJw2ymtiMc-K04MLdY-Ya18hJ_RrCA3plZmBGSBrqbDGvqp8hXRkSmDTkdZRKmXX-MKh6Yv2isLD8EOI7Apu7ZuTwTRLGO_lfF5K2OxIjPAM29Os-uaF3JRyTu0FyRmgsmKynrvIzrP9X1_4N48hJn3FsSDVW6wPsQ4z8798YjiwPoT9pQ45xpsNirNTPc6B9BMESYBUC38DXOJtmn_XEneqVLsYmeRMYF4EDnk)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=07a712003160441bb61e8f6e4024bca2&_e=JJjYiIPVPLBdRXWbnrAdbiLjtJonvSKm8cczXV0SzYAfKSbyKtsR-NbBZGzhna4SEoc0vNqra6vHThaby9E18nHHPITdTxZm1E9Nt-AkMArhzjnJV2HprA9ncTN6oL69FWkNUxP3XdZ-kajOTKvqpdqhRzJw2ymtiMc-K04MLdY-Ya18hJ_RrCA3plZmBGSBrqbDGvqp8hXRkSmDTkdZRC7-JDBm9XLBYsyIs_AfOSzFdPDxo5I5fKGa2H183UcNnB_0ROElleKyzGKBuuBZVrBXrXGPOgAFSo5v9NLXtxgegPTOPLFSRGhOn0DmCxAaTtO0lcMVUNfQptbmngke0FeEBXtvKrW9rCGSBfuW0e1tGAfEEoZK1_F_IAXE3mmi)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=07a712003160441bb61e8f6e4024bca2&_e=JJjYiIPVPLBdRXWbnrAdbiLjtJonvSKm8cczXV0SzYAfKSbyKtsR-NbBZGzhna4SEoc0vNqra6vHThaby9E18nHHPITdTxZm1E9Nt-AkMArhzjnJV2HprA9ncTN6oL69FWkNUxP3XdZ-kajOTKvqpdqhRzJw2ymtiMc-K04MLdY-Ya18hJ_RrCA3plZmBGSBrqbDGvqp8hXRkSmDTkdZROL0iYjya4RIggLo8vElu0s99j-IMjLsUCwmo02GosGmHdII3EMnC3ZKvxbPauG0UneT7Avw1UpwuZ3wa1M3bCd_PRExNvJGotZIp_Z0LUhP56flSmyLZJF6gz0Vufhp3_pqzYTLbBSbWjacZw3UlnAilPzvi5bxkOlcpaIr_xNR) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=07a712003160441bb61e8f6e4024bca2&_e=JJjYiIPVPLBdRXWbnrAdbiLjtJonvSKm8cczXV0SzYAfKSbyKtsR-NbBZGzhna4SEoc0vNqra6vHThaby9E18nHHPITdTxZm1E9Nt-AkMArhzjnJV2HprA9ncTN6oL69FWkNUxP3XdZ-kajOTKvqpdqhRzJw2ymtiMc-K04MLdY-Ya18hJ_RrCA3plZmBGSBrqbDGvqp8hXRkSmDTkdZRIFEAB__p-nYvox9rhpIRtG40VVqylRPOOyXxJdOFJnbRu3jh0wOABQkRubYfQPIDqRqdb4-sqHUv09Lecb0PjzZACmAhLv6UVzjKSMVbWSZpD3yiMzkXLzXBOS0vLoFzG2nad8zVVPdfkDvYmrUHdeRsK-Svw-apL1wEe-ffB4a)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**
**Chairwoman, University of Iowa YAF**

Reston, VA 20191-1556

That’s why we can’t afford to have ANY missteps. We’ve always been behind in fundraising, but if we all band together in these final months, we can prove we have the grassroots support to steamroll Sherrod Brown on November 5th. Moreover, it will ensure we can keep up and compete in this race! If we fall short, it will give Brown and his far-left backers the confidence to attack us even harder and increase their already astronomical spending. Sherrod Brown is outraising us massively – in fact, he’s been raising more than any other Democrat on the ballot! The Senate majority and America First movement hang in the balance, and Thank you for taking action. For America, Bernie Moreno GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90688025/491336085/1380915657?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.08.12_CAROLEKING_B1_F1_S2_C1_u1_N-T2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDcyM2VkYy1kMzU4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-UHK9vQqYMmZ8fWoLP7-s_ToKxCzr22KZUrVSVh8h20=) Hi Peter, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.

I first visited New Hampshire in the early 1960s when I learned to ski in lace-up leather ski boots with cable bindings. And I have friends in Manchester that I’ve been visiting for decades.

Their neighbor, Joyce Craig, was the first woman elected mayor of Manchester in 2017. And now Joyce is running for governor of New Hampshire.

[Will you join me in helping Joyce Craig get her message out to everyone in New Hampshire whose vote she hopes to earn? ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90688028/491336087/1380915657?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.08.12_CAROLEKING_B1_F1_S2_C1_u1_N-T2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDcyM2VkYy1kMzU4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-UHK9vQqYMmZ8fWoLP7-s_ToKxCzr22KZUrVSVh8h20=)

Joyce has executive experience, a record of improving people’s lives, and common sense. When I spoke to her recently, she said, “I want every child in my state to receive a quality public education. Republicans are diverting public tax money to vouchers for private education. Public dollars should go to public schools.”

**I agree. Do you?** | [**SUPPORT JOYCE CRAIG >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90688030/491336091/43219686?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.08.12_CAROLEKING_B1_F1_S2_C1_u1_N-T2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDcyM2VkYy1kMzU4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-UHK9vQqYMmZ8fWoLP7-s_ToKxCzr22KZUrVSVh8h20=)
---
Elected Republicans such as former Senator Kelly Ayotte and the current governor of New Hampshire have fallen in line behind the wannabe dictator who lies and denies what we’ve seen with our own eyes. (The rhymes were unintentional, but the point is factual.)

The leader of the cruelty caucus has had so many conflicting positions on women’s health care that even he doesn’t remember them.

Joyce’s position is clear. She stands up for people and their rights. It’s why she released a comprehensive plan to protect reproductive health care in New Hampshire.

[With Republican legislators’ relentless attacks on personal liberties, Granite Staters need a governor who will stand up for their rights and freedoms.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90688031/491336092/1380915657?amount=10&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2024.08.12_CAROLEKING_B1_F1_S2_C1_u1_N-T2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzgwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDcyM2VkYy1kMzU4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-UHK9vQqYMmZ8fWoLP7-s_ToKxCzr22KZUrVSVh8h20=)

What about jobs? Ensuring that hardworking families have good-paying local jobs is personal for Joyce. Her dad was a union electrician who had to work in another state because there were no jobs where they lived.

“It’s heartbreaking for kids when a parent can’t find work close to home,” Joyce said. “We have to do better!”

body:
Beth Ann Rosica | B+L Featured Columnist | | | |
---
| | |
---
| _**Will Shapiro step up after being turned down?**_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c86c75df02&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| "Speculations abound as to the reason Shapiro was not selected to run with Kamala Harris as Vice President.

We will likely never learn the real reasons, though the reality is probably some combination of the issues, ranging from his religion and stance on Israel to the perception that he is overly ambitious and might upstage Harris to his failure to address the sexual harassment allegations in his own office to breaking his commitment to enact school choice options for students in failing schools.

While the rest of the country has moved on and off Shapiro, we in Pennsylvania are left wondering whether he learned anything as a result of this process. Will we see a different governing style in the aftermath of his experience in the limelight?

Assuming his political aspirations have not changed and he still plans a presidential run in 2028 or later, Shapiro now has an opportunity to address the issues that may have resulted in being passed over for the VP spot..."

## About Beth Ann Rosica:
---
| |
---
Beth Ann Rosica holds a Ph.D. in Education and has dedicated her career to advocating on behalf of at-risk children and families. She became politically active during the extended school closures, speaking out about the detrimental effects on children. Beth Ann led the local grassroots movement to open schools and eliminate mandatory masks while assisting school board candidates across the state and country with their campaigns. She has a consulting business and covers education issues for _Broad + Liberty_. Beth Ann resides in West Chester, PA with her husband and two teenage sons.
---

The media keeps giving Trump free air time to spread his lies

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90688652/491338323/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTUzMGQwYjItZDQ1OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0ZfaL9a90z9z6kIgE2yKqADyIcI-SbZ6uaqbeJLYP9s=&emci=2dfbdb9c-cf58-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=a530d0b2-d458-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
We are fewer than 90 days from election day, and the mainstream media still has no idea how to cover Donald Trump’s campaign for president.
**On Thursday, Trump held a 64 minute news conference that aired live and unedited on every major cable news network in the U.S. He used the free air time to tell more than 162 lies – that’s more than two every minute.**
MSNBC host Lawrence O’Donnell used his opening monologue that same night to criticize and warn the media (including his own bosses at MSNBC):
_“It’s 2016 all over again. The same mistakes are being made. I have never seen an industry slower at learning from its own stupid mistakes than the American news business.”_
**[We’ll get into why the media is struggling to cover Trump’s campaign fairly in a second, but if you support COURIER’s mission to hold the mainstream media accountable for their biased Trump coverage, can you chip in $20 now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90688661/491338330/-593472309?refcode=20240812-EM-MSNBCTrumpConference&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTUzMGQwYjItZDQ1OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0ZfaL9a90z9z6kIgE2yKqADyIcI-SbZ6uaqbeJLYP9s=)**
Trump and his team are floundering, Peter. Harris has received widespread support, including a massive increase in both fundraising and poll numbers.
So Trump turned to his standard campaign strategy: sharing countless lies in an attempt to get media attention. **The worst part? It worked.**
Every major cable news channel, including MSNBC, aired his hour-long press conference in full, with no live fact-checking or editing. He had a free platform to spread endless lies to anyone who tuned in.
As Lawrence O’Donnell pointed out, these networks had the capacity and ability to provide live fact-checking. But they didn’t.
These networks also had the capacity and ability to air Kamala Harris’ speech the same day. But they didn’t. They made no attempt to even appear balanced.
The truth is, Donald Trump drives an insane amount of views and clicks for these media companies, and those drive profits. Balance, fact-checking, and truth-telling aren’t the priority for the mainstream media – money is. The future of democracy be damned.
**These are the exact same mistakes the media made in 2016. We can’t let them keep getting away with it.**
Here’s the good news: COURIER was founded for this moment. We saw what happened in 2016, and we want to make sure it never happens again.
Our reporters work around the clock to hold the mainstream media accountable for platforming Trump and his lies. And we publish our own factual reporting on the issues that matter most, including fact-checking the former president.

body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/2e71289923c0/invitation-two-parties-two-veterans-one-conversation-rep-lalota-rep-ryan-special-session-with-president-carter-alumni-13542450?e=33f53a5b1a)

| | | |

| | | | Friends,

Nearly half of voters in the U.S. – including an estimated majority of veteran voters – are Independents. Unfortunately, in many state primaries which determine a majority of the seats in Congress and state legislatures, these voters are restricted from participating in our election process.

This is a significant issue for our democracy...

Former FBI Agent, Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick, and Former For Country Caucus Co-Chair and U.S. Marine, Jared Golden, are leading the charge on fixing this issue with the [Let America Vote Act, ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=01b42eb34f&e=33f53a5b1a)which would enfranchise tens of millions of independent Americans and enable these citizens to vote in primaries.

With Honor Action joined No Labels and Unite America to support the bill and we are inviting you to join a virtual meeting to announce the addition of Veterans for All Voters to our coalition on Tuesday, August 13th from 7:00pm - 7:45pm EST.

You can register for the event to hear more about the issue and the bill from Rep. Fitzpatrick and Rep. Golden by clicking below:

body:
Right now, America’s biggest adversaries are working to surpass our nation’s military capabilities.

| | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=78c8b30ddf104f1cba4531619efdac2c&_t=sABjjADTXnyoxk360HQWZkah_EQxUc9jufFJUndiEVbTTbd5kMD-Z9MoYO2PHih9dZtQ53w_rBJT3z4ur37M6-8JD75JxdAXqH8V40Flq8xhEF5IX1Bez-IuifugS7DL)_

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=78c8b30ddf104f1cba4531619efdac2c&_e=y3L2ONRt355gqvEqQewk-Q1Su1ns3pTU9HDTnsInvQC3OF-lW6tqHvz3dpOZ-hhgDfe1BKJO031EEke7AAIxN7NX7soiRZUcybPWbFT1lguD_AVSW3mTMqvZBHrPSAEaKBmB00NCQoWvikxh6Agj9E8VnH9g0rSIoX_77I5OA4RWp5qV5JF2VYT-0QCMPdLAzA2EzwG_ZHWzPrglkonAC7fbkMTIzlTHLbmeRqsJNIKIZAWAOOtQ3CIYFQcCzwN-lCeaPfLDF9N_H6rlhYJdszDfiB0nOinGuwuikA4tzbUeHTBfR06QWzSFg4yBWdLB1X9-6ymXTBqrPVzhArh2CtVLkhJV-Rb-Gy8EVTy0neEPvKtzTQBIJlh1e2PeMLvC)

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=78c8b30ddf104f1cba4531619efdac2c&_e=y3L2ONRt355gqvEqQewk-Q1Su1ns3pTU9HDTnsInvQC3OF-lW6tqHvz3dpOZ-hhgDfe1BKJO031EEke7AAIxN7NX7soiRZUcybPWbFT1lguD_AVSW3mTMqvZBHrPSAEaKBmB00NCQoWvikxh6Agj9E8VnH9g0rSIoX_77I5OA4RWp5qV5JF2VYT-0QCMPdLAzA2EzwG_ZHWzPrglkonACwroUboutBZNz6O1XLgA8XhKVxZPFKv5bitM0gI3oSH_CH1B89JU1pCIyUaG6BHtgnSNAtBnaO7dSzbr39h4pAP05TxJHAzFHBk7TnK_PCBKgBhZ73veyKlHomeBXD8cl-74BLsoo2vFHZ814eVyJpYewIIo9eOZ86nSwgyV6-0i) Fellow Conservative,

Right now, America's biggest adversaries are working to surpass our nation's military capabilities. And critical problems exist in many areas of the world:
* Countries like Iran act deceitfully and use their military to bully other countries.

* Rogue states like North Korea and Syria pose direct threats to their regions and America's security.

* And the leaders of countries like China and Russia have proven they will do whatever they can to increase government control and state surveillance of their citizens.

On top of all this, our country's military equipment--including planes, tanks, and ships--is decades-old and years past its useful service.

With information like this, you would think our elected leaders would push to ensure a strong future for our nation's military. But some of them are actually looking to reduce America's defense spending. Apparently, they would rather prioritize issues like climate change.

That's why I'm emailing you today.

I'm told that you are a conservative who wants to ensure that our country remains a beacon of hope, opportunity, and liberty for all the world. And I understand that you are just as concerned as I am about the future of America's defense.

[So, today, I want to make sure you get a FREE copy of The Heritage Foundation's _2024 Index of U.S. Military Strength_.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=78c8b30ddf104f1cba4531619efdac2c&_e=y3L2ONRt355gqvEqQewk-Q1Su1ns3pTU9HDTnsInvQC3OF-lW6tqHvz3dpOZ-hhgDfe1BKJO031EEke7AAIxN7NX7soiRZUcybPWbFT1lguD_AVSW3mTMqvZBHrPSAEaKBmB00NCQoWvikxh6Agj9E8VnH9g0rSIoX_77I5OA4RWp5qV5JF2VYT-0QCMPdLAzA2EzwG_ZHWzPrglkonACw0fdxlS67O8JH8qMQQtFLWJc8BvRm0-xt_MniYPfkGLTEnE4aNmYA2HcX8LVytno6PzxjxBAXMt_qLXQc1lCaGDWYPblsxhoI041Hjb3XYqDwhsfEjLZWnP2-aIPqm3Sa3EoclSJLDoZfbPsB73yvl3WfjKGJRp4vSILhahNXlC)

We publish this report to help decision-makers in government see how conditions have evolved in the past year and where American strengths, challenges, and opportunities for improvement lie.

But we also make this important resource available to the general public, so that you are aware of how well--or poorly--the government is handling this sacred task.

In addition to all of this, you can use this Index to explore topics like:
* Understanding risk in the great competition with the Chinese Communist Party.

* What we risk if we fail to fully modernize the U.S. nuclear deterrent.

* How prioritizing climate change and DEI training weakens America's military.

name: Tulsi Gabbard
subject: I took on the Clinton Machine. And I paid the price for it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
Aloha – this is Tulsi Gabbard. I was targeted by my former party for the high crime of standing up to Hillary Clinton at the height of her power in 2016.

| |

---
| | | | [](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=853058.122.1.a08e617a65c57d4fa9d5aef6781fe860 "Tulsi Gabbard")
---

I took on the Clinton Machine.

And I paid the price for it.

**Aloha – this is FORMER Democrat Tulsi Gabbard. My former party came after for me for the high crime of standing up to Hillary Clinton at the height of her power in 2016.**

A lot has changed since then – for starters, I’m no longer a Democrat.

Like so many, the Democrat Party left me behind and became the Party of corporate elitists, warmongers, and anti-freedom propagandists. _(In fact, I literally wrote the book about doing what’s RIGHT for our country and LEAVING the Democrat Party!)_

The rot is too deep – it can’t be fixed, it must be driven out entirely.

That’s why I’m sending you this email. I have a plan to bring down the ENTIRE cabal of Elites running the Democrat Party. We need to raise 100K dollars by tonight so we can begin to put our plan into action.

We’re short of that goal by about 7%.

_**[So – with a humble heart, a spine of steel, and love of our great country – I respectfully ask you for a small contribution of 10 or 25 dollars. Will you stand with me?](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=853058.123.1.c7b9b9a0af681f0ad6d81f269152c449 "So – with a humble heart and spine of steel – I respectfully ask you for a small contribution of 10 or 25 bucks. Do you think you could do that for me?")**_
---
**[](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=853058.124.1.2b20a0512977493f52ae015a0c159462)[**YES >>**](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=853058.125.1.a2a4e5013b2e88394ab5f67a1523a74c)_[**NO >>**](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=853058.126.1.c923513a97bcf8d9c97c4c701d292a81)**
---
**We set this ambitious goal because this is a no-fail mission – we must defeat the Democrat elite at the ballot box and send a powerful message that we, the people will not allow those who are destroying our freedom to remain in power.**

_**[Your contribution to our cause of freedom would make a tremendous difference. So I’m asking you: Can you please help us?](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=853058.127.1.c0a8cbc95c17c513b3e656a3ec48ca61 "Your contribution to our cause of freedom would make a tremendous difference. So I’m asking you: Can you please help us? ")**_

God bless you. God bless America.

_– Tulsi_

---

Friend - leaders like Pete Buttigieg, Bernie Sanders, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Robert Reich are leading the charge to ditch the Electoral College and switch to a national popular vote system. Why?
➜ The Electoral College is the reason Trump won in 2016, despite losing the popular vote by millions
➜ Joe Biden nearly lost the presidency even though he won the popular vote by a historic margin
➜ Every day new leaders join our movement, which means we can abolish the Electoral College and give us a true democracy
We’re so close to getting rid of the Electoral College, but we need to bring in more pro-popular vote supporters across the country to cross the finish line. We keep talking about this because it's true: We already have 76% of the states needed to make the popular vote the law of the land because they have signed the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.
The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 16 states plus DC have already joined, accounting for 206 electoral votes of the 270 needed to win.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: New Mexico is on the brink of turning red, and Nella Domenici is our best chance to make that happen. | Friend, As we enter the crucial final stretch of this election, I want to share a powerful truth with you: New Mexico is on the brink of turning red, and Nella Domenici is our best chance to make that happen. Recent polls show Nella within the margin of error in her race for the U.S. Senate seat against the entrenched incumbent, Martin Heinrich. She also outraised him last quarter! I’ve seen firsthand how transformative it is to work with a Republican majority in Congress. During my time as Speaker of the House, the balance of power made all the difference in advancing a conservative agenda that worked FOR the People. Imagine what we can achieve if we elect Nella Domenici,finally flip New Mexico red, and take back the Senate. Nella is a strong, principled, independent leader who will stand up for our values and work tirelessly to bring common-sense solutions to the Senate. Her commitment to border security, economic growth, and restoring American strength is exactly what New Mexico – and our country – needs right now. The stakes are high, and the radical left is pouring a ton of resources to hold onto seats like this one in New Mexico. So please, let’s seize the moment and make history together. Thank you for standing with us in this critical fight. Warm regards, Newt Gingrich P.S. Time is running out, and every day counts in this razor-thin race. | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **Peter, I’m a white dude, and I’m proudly voting for Kamala Harris!!!**
When President Biden endorsed Vice President Harris to become the Democratic nominee for president, lots of folks stepped up right away to show their support.
Tens of thousands of people joined Black Women for Harris and White Women for Harris calls over Zoom to talk about the work ahead of us in this pivotal election.
I decided to help launch a group called White Dudes for Harris because I think we need to stand up, BE VISIBLE, and show the widespread support among the white men who are ready to fight hard to elect the first woman president this November.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240812?refcode=em20240812&refcode2=1048_587540_mHcVcX&akid=1048%2E587540%2EmHcVcX)

I know Democrats can win in November — but we need to maintain this energy and enthusiasm to ensure that voters turn out to the polls and make it happen.

I believe Aaron Dimmock meets this standard. He supports Donald Trump's America-first agenda, understands the challenges we face, and has laid out a clear, positive vision for Florida and our Nation. But, he can't do it alone. He needs our support to win and bring fresh, strong leadership to Washington. Your contribution, no matter the size, will make a big difference to Aaron and his team. It will help them spread his message, reach more voters, and secure the victory America needs. Together we can bring about the change we desire – and I believe the change begins in Florida. subject: There's NEVER been an openly transgender member of Congress!

body:
"Today, anti-trans forces had to come before a trans person in the big chair – me."
#
_"For years, trans people have had to go before anti-trans lawmakers in the big chair. Today, anti-trans forces had to come before a trans person in the big chair – me."
\- Sarah McBride_
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240812-1?refcode=em20240812-1-990&amount=5&refcode2=990_21716_9NQcWk&akid=990%2E21716%2E9NQcWk)
Hi, it's David Hogg.
Last month marked the 7-year anniversary of Donald Trump **reversing decades of progress** by BANNING transgender people from serving in the military.
**Back then, there wasn't a single transgender member of Congress to stand up to Trump... there still isn't. Which is why my organization, Leaders We Deserve, has endorsed Sarah McBride in her race to represent Delaware in the U.S. House.**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240812-1?refcode=em20240812-1-990&amount=5&refcode2=990_21716_9NQcWk&akid=990%2E21716%2E9NQcWk)
Sarah would be the FIRST-ever transgender member of Congress — after already being the first openly transgender person elected to a state senate seat. It is CRITICAL that we have her voice not just at the table but at the head of the table, as Republicans launch nonstop attacks on the trans community.
[**We need young progressive leaders like Sarah in office. Can you make a $5 donation to her campaign to help her win her primary election in a few weeks?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240812-1?refcode=em20240812-1-990&amount=5&refcode2=990_21716_9NQcWk&akid=990%2E21716%2E9NQcWk)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240812-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240812-1-990&refcode2=990_21716_9NQcWk&akid=990%2E21716%2E9NQcWk)**
Listen, I know as a supporter of Sarah McBride that I don't have to tell you representation matters. You're here because you KNOW it does.
So I won't explain why it's so important to end the absence of transgender people at the table in Congress. Instead, I'm going to tell you why Sarah is so damn amazing.
**She's been a political badass for years.** Sarah worked for the late Attorney General Beau Biden and served in the Obama-Biden White House. She also served as the national spokesperson for the Human Rights Campaign, the nation’s largest LGBTQ equal rights organization. In 2016, she became the first openly transgender person to address a major party convention when she spoke at the Democratic convention. And in 2020, she made history when she was elected to the Delaware State Senate.
**She's fought for progressive values as a state senator.** In her first term, Sarah passed paid family and medical leave for workers in Delaware — the largest expansion of the state's social safety net in decades. She's also successfully passed bills expanding access to health care, requiring mental health and media literacy education in public schools, promoting green technologies, and preventing lead poisoning in young people.
**She leads with love.** When Republicans went after transgender kids in her state, Sarah declared boldly, "To the trans young people and their families who are watching today... your government sees you. And for the first time ever, really understands you. You are loved, and you are worthy. You are part of the vibrant diversity that makes this state great."
[**Sarah is EXACTLY the kind of leader we deserve — so let's fight to make sure she wins this seat. Please make a $5 donation to her campaign now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240812-1?refcode=em20240812-1-990&amount=5&refcode2=990_21716_9NQcWk&akid=990%2E21716%2E9NQcWk)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240812-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240812-1-990&refcode2=990_21716_9NQcWk&akid=990%2E21716%2E9NQcWk)**
Thank you,
David Hogg
Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/CSZ-Dkza7Lml4aW8Scdy1g~~/AARclAA~/RgRonPp4P0RwaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtd2Fsei1taWxpdGFyeS12amQtcG9wLz91dG1fdGM9Uk9OMi0yMDI0MDgxMlcDc3BjQgpmq0FgumaqnUxtUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/CSZ-Dkza7Lml4aW8Scdy1g~~/AARclAA~/RgRonPp4P0RwaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtd2Fsei1taWxpdGFyeS12amQtcG9wLz91dG1fdGM9Uk9OMi0yMDI0MDgxMlcDc3BjQgpmq0FgumaqnUxtUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/CSZ-Dkza7Lml4aW8Scdy1g~~/AARclAA~/RgRonPp4P0RwaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtd2Fsei1taWxpdGFyeS12amQtcG9wLz91dG1fdGM9Uk9OMi0yMDI0MDgxMlcDc3BjQgpmq0FgumaqnUxtUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)_**

My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.

From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well. | | | | ~~ | Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me. I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind. Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream. When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into. But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life. ~~ Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable. My commitment to this nation goes beyond words – I’ve walked the walk, defending the very freedoms we hold dear. | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f4855ec891e548039772f4ca933ccb64&_e=USN8kzvyJ_Iw4j4PvgclCQUlRSzuWnfYcgYL0SIgGDyEyS3Bx6vT8Tvn6SihklCaJyFn9cTS-EBRuCiNoesM8ndw0s-w2qgjfqD7bKDHbBK6Ld4yznPzO9kNb4OMsluqyOmpNwizmn828HZKfXmKCf1mDEePzLK1-R9qbWw1K9PGa_g-TOxoxvBSW_55O83DScdQloq1vW-d9_L4LWq4g7oFXv66uhrDXu5Nnl3cR0CI6xhjKhXh58i6J5TTQpY8HRQjV6WWX1UYkPnBL2jbmLubl-m1-AgUlEJW3qj95VmNmiqlNidatTKRSr-goezxvHltPg4QfEHe4yCRCr-pHDHWIjoiBwKZlc4y-Hdxb4TBOkbmHVaDi4TiQKKGVqtU)
Fellow American,

In times like these, we need leaders who have truly answered the call to serve. **As someone born and raised in Stockton in a proud military family, I didn’t just talk about service – _I lived it._**

Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your day!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240812-2-900&t=3&akid=1766%2E135344%2Ee-9niI)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

| | Dear friend,
I’m reaching out today to ask for your help in protecting the principles that make Wisconsin strong: fiscal responsibility, accountability, and limited government.

On August 13th, you’ll have the opportunity to vote on two amendments to our state constitution—Questions 1 and 2. These amendments are crucial for restoring balance to our state government and ensuring that our hard-earned tax dollars are spent wisely. **You should vote YES!**
---
---
**Here’s What’s at Stake:** Right now, the Governor has the power to spend billions in federal funds without any input from the state legislature—the very body that represents you, the people. This unchecked authority has led to reckless spending, with your tax dollars being funneled into pet projects and special interest groups without transparency or oversight.

When I was serving in the State Senate, I saw firsthand how Governor Jim Doyle did everything he could to spend, spend, spend. And Governor Evers is doing the same thing now. And that's why we need to enact these Constitutional Amendments. **By Voting YES on August 13th, You’ll:**
* **Reinforce the “Power of the Purse”:** These amendments will make sure that the legislature—your voice in Madison—has the final say on how every dollar is spent, putting a stop to unchecked executive spending.
* **Protect Taxpayer Dollars:** Voting YES ensures that government spending is controlled and responsible, preventing wasteful use of federal funds that could lead to higher taxes down the road.
* **Uphold Conservative Values:** By requiring legislative approval for the expenditure of federal funds, these amendments return power to the people and protect our state from the dangers of big government.

We have a chance to make a real difference on August 13th. By voting YES on Questions 1 and 2, we can ensure that Wisconsin remains a beacon of conservative values and fiscal sanity. Thank you for standing with me in this important fight. Please encourage your friends and family to get out and vote YES on August 13th.

Together, let’s protect Wisconsin’s future.
---
Sincerely, **Glenn Grothman**

clean_body: Stand up for fiscal sanity| | | | | Dear friend, I’m reaching out today to ask for your help in protecting the principles that make Wisconsin strong: fiscal responsibility, accountability, and limited government. On August 13th, you’ll have the opportunity to vote on two amendments to our state constitution—Questions 1 and 2. These amendments are crucial for restoring balance to our state government and ensuring that our hard-earned tax dollars are spent wisely. You should vote YES! Here’s What’s at Stake: Right now, the Governor has the power to spend billions in federal funds without any input from the state legislature—the very body that represents you, the people. This unchecked authority has led to reckless spending, with your tax dollars being funneled into pet projects and special interest groups without transparency or oversight. When I was serving in the State Senate, I saw firsthand how Governor Jim Doyle did everything he could to spend, spend, spend. And Governor Evers is doing the same thing now. And that's why we need to enact these Constitutional Amendments. By Voting YES on August 13th, You’ll: Reinforce the “Power of the Purse”: These amendments will make sure that the legislature—your voice in Madison—has the final say on how every dollar is spent, putting a stop to unchecked executive spending. Protect Taxpayer Dollars: Voting YES ensures that government spending is controlled and responsible, preventing wasteful use of federal funds that could lead to higher taxes down the road. Uphold Conservative Values: By requiring legislative approval for the expenditure of federal funds, these amendments return power to the people and protect our state from the dangers of big government. We have a chance to make a real difference on August 13th. By voting YES on Questions 1 and 2, we can ensure that Wisconsin remains a beacon of conservative values and fiscal sanity. Thank you for standing with me in this important fight. Please encourage your friends and family to get out and vote YES on August 13th. Together, let’s protect Wisconsin’s future. Sincerely, Glenn Grothman** | | | | | | | FOLLOW GLENN ON SOCIAL MEDIA! | | | | ---|---|---|--- Glenn Grothman for Congress P.O. # It's Never Too Early to Plan Your Vote!
---
Neighbors, another election season is in full swing! With just 85 days to go I want to make sure you have all the info on the important dates and deadlines that will soon be coming at us fast!
**2024 Indiana Election Deadlines:**
October 7: Voter Registration Closes
October 8: Early Voting Begins
October 24: Deadline to Request an Absentee Ballot - _[Check your eligibility here.](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmluLmdvdi9zb3MvZWxlY3Rpb25zL3ZvdGVyLWluZm9ybWF0aW9uL3dheXMtdG8tdm90ZS9hYnNlbnRlZS12b3RpbmcvI0lOX1BFUlNPTl9BQlNFTlRFRV9WT1RJTkciLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwODEyLjk4OTM3NjMxIn0.m97F-TdvUJ6oMKdZhr0gOicSOdWg3JHK_o_p1au55yk/s/2950175210/br/247279325800-l)
_ November 4 @12PM: Early Voting Ends
November 5: 6AM - 6PM: Election Day
_Note: All absentee ballots**must be received** by 6PM on Election Day!_
It's so important to make a plan to vote. You can always use [indianavoters.com](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDcsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXZvdGVycy5pbi5nb3YvIiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDgxMi45ODkzNzYzMSJ9.jkeBkfBl4dVXpsvgvgqi0s9JGVrnKGnAYqPQixzJG-Y/s/2950175210/br/247279325800-l) to check your registration, apply to vote by absentee ballot or traveling board, and find voting locations near you. ## Applications Open for My Youth Advisory Council!
|
---
Calling all motivated and passionate young minds! Are you 14-18 years old and eager to make a difference in our community? Join the State Senate District 46 Student Advisory Council and be the voice of your generation.
**
Here’s why you should consider joining** :
**Purpose** : The Student Advisory Council is your platform to shape policies and initiatives that directly impact youth across our state. Your ideas and insights will help guide decision-making and ensure the youth perspective is heard in your state government.

**Meetings** : We will meet 1-2 times per quarter, allowing you to balance your commitments while still making a meaningful contribution. We will have in-person and virtual options for our meetings.

**Commitment** : To give you the opportunity to delve deep into issues and build lasting connections, the commitment to the council is for 2 years.
**[Click here to fill out an application](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMTEsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vaW5kaWFuYXNlbmF0ZWRlbW9jcmF0cy5vcmcvc2VuYXRvcnMvczQ2L3lhYy00Ni8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwODEyLjk4OTM3NjMxIn0.k196jASktEIQB39w_ykVtkd-ICc87jobK8FXOddtTC4/s/2950175210/br/247279325800-l).**

The League of Women Voters has organized several trainings in the coming weeks to help Hoosiers master the voter registration process. If my handy guide above helped you confirm your own registration, I encourage you to join great nonprofit organizations like this one and help others do the same!

You can watch the meeting live starting at 7PM ! Read the full text of the Council's Vision Zero plan: | DEADLINE EXTENDED: Applications Open for My Youth Advisory Council! | Calling all motivated and passionate young minds! Are you 14-18 years old and eager to make a difference in our community? Join the State Senate District 46 Student Advisory Council and be the voice of your generation. Here’s why you should consider joining : Purpose : The Student Advisory Council is your platform to shape policies and initiatives that directly impact youth across our state. Your ideas and insights will help guide decision-making and ensure the youth perspective is heard in your state government. Meetings : We will meet 1-2 times per quarter, allowing you to balance your commitments while still making a meaningful contribution. We will have in-person and virtual options for our meetings. Commitment : To give you the opportunity to delve deep into issues and build lasting connections, the commitment to the council is for 2 years. . Thank you for your interest in serving our community! STORIES SHAPING OUR STATE We hit a grave milestone last week when we marked one year since the near-total ban on abortion care that passed in the 2022 special session took effect. Data since has proven what we've always known to be true: bans don't stop abortions, but they do endanger all who need to access reproductive healthcare. A new state database will now empower Hoosiers to compare the price of healthcare services across providers. Learn more here from Indiana Capital Chronicle! The League of Women Voters has organized several trainings in the coming weeks to help Hoosiers master the voter registration process. If my handy guide above helped you confirm your own registration, I encourage you to join great nonprofit organizations like this one and help others do the same! | COMMUNITY RESOURCES To view my state government resource guide, "Hunley Community Resource Guide". | | | | | Created and distributed by the Indiana Senate Democratic Communications Office Nancy.Singh@iga.in.gov Kyle.Casteel@iga.in.gov Molly.Neary@iga.in.gov ---|---|--- SUBSCRIBER SERVICES: | | | *

| | Our shared values – working hard, caring for each other, and serving the community – guide my work in Congress to serve the people of Northwest Washington. These values and our record of progress have earned my campaign the endorsements of national, state, and local elected officials, organizations, and leaders. As we continue to attract new endorsements, I want to highlight a few you may have missed in the last few weeks and months. [Full Endorsement List](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90694537/491358965/1269197245?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NGQzNzI4YS1lMTU4LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jaYVDhhQoAuYVNBVjCodvM_7hzbp7h1JrhiGJVSC6Gg=&emci=6ff948f3-d84a-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=84d3728a-e158-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9494239)
* **I will always advocate for gender equality** — but I am especially proud to stand alongside the activists at NOW PAC to drive progress at a time when basic rights are under attack by right-wing extremists. We cannot allow anti-choice extremists to gain any ground in Congress. Guaranteeing the ability to make our own health care decisions, ensuring equal pay for equal work, and pushing for stronger economic opportunity are fundamental to the quality of life for all of us.

* **Gun violence is a public health crisis** , and I am grateful for organizations including Newtown Action Alliance, Moms Demand Action, Giffords PAC, and the Alliance for Gun Responsibility Victory Fund for their work to curb the epidemic. I am committed to ending the violence and leading the charge for common-sense gun reform. I voted for the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, the first major legislation on gun safety since 1994. While the reforms in this legislation do not go as far as I would prefer, they are a step in the right direction and will save lives.

* **League of Conservation Voters and the Sierra Club are powerful forces in American environmental politics to promote a greener and more sustainable future.** I am honored to have their support as I run for re-election in Congress, and I am grateful for their work to keep places like Northwest Washington beautiful for future generations. As we deal with warmer temperatures, rising sea levels, and climate-caused disasters, I will continue working to ensure our infrastructure can handle the changing climate and keep our communities safe.

* **As the Ranking Member of the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I earned the endorsement of Transportation for Washington (T4WA).** Over the last few years, through the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and the Community Project Funding Requests program, I have been able to bring over a hundred million dollars in funding to the 2nd District to invest in our community and create jobs. From upgrades to roads and bridges in Skagit County and Lynnwood, to safe routes to school in Lynden, to road improvements that will make possible a green technology center in Everett — these projects have a tangible impact on our community.

* **I am proud to represent all of my constituents in Congress and to have the support of Democrats for Diversity & Inclusion in doing so. **Protecting diversity and inclusion is important, and I am proud that DDI has recognized our work.

Whether it is the advancement of equality, gun safety, or environmental protection — these organizations recognize our work to protect our shared values. With your support, I hope to have the opportunity to bring the policy objectives above and more to fruition in Congress. Friends,
---
I had the honor of sitting down with my good friend, Mike Huckabee, and talk about the issues impacting our daily life. We shared stories from our times as governor, and talked about how we can fight for the policies that can make America great once again! Watch the interview below, or watch the whole episode [HERE](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=68f7b30217014852b7529b34ea63680c&_e=TFAROiMc30EbMLqOA9-XQF5zwMfSrbDOXw-GCfAeK7hjL_9x_RKZ2h6aHUISIMF0eqOcw0QL8YJ6-jEO1h0449hLnhkmLwbTZpPySkvx7zFTjCfPWaX1St3Z9Am3Jp89q5UnMdQ1KVTo0b8h-FRoXbecpRVRoDRyKPnJ3-htSUM6m7Su7gf4wivlLaouKxxIYwQRYZO7Jc8YKFObIndj4wt--D3z-32MMZirblNjjTk%3D). _**WATCH THE VIDEO**_

[](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=68f7b30217014852b7529b34ea63680c&_e=TFAROiMc30EbMLqOA9-XQF5zwMfSrbDOXw-GCfAeK7jJ4lMmWgFtMtp2nPcY-wqsQP1wIizc2mSrQxyETTjQ7D5UiQM4iue1IYRoPR2hjebIJGmFKumttCmCCN_lM1maCbWleYBvUQFQyVGJqInDjsOMpHmkdHh_CFp5ogDm1SRTwfaLIGqpPP6v2wOuqg-LTQi2jJS2AY68YyQhz0z_0XR2-l7OnttuhARNEDFkG-k%3D)
---
Here are some good quotes from the interview: "I'm so proud to see so many states, so many Governors are doing this it's growing in Florida in Texas, and Iowa all over the country. I think the Wuhan virus really impacted, infected the NEA because so many parents woke up when their kids were sent home so many parents saw the radical nonsense being taught in so many of our public schools. Now look if you happen to live in an area with a great public School, God bless you, but for those parents that want a home school or for those parents trapped in a neighborhood with failing Public Schools they should have more choices."
---
God Bless, Bobby

clean_body: “...a national ban on abortion pills that would affect even states that protect abortion rights” | Peter, There’s a lot to say about how Project 2025 would be a disaster for our country, but we want to take a moment to highlight just how dangerous its abortion rights policy really is: | “Project 2025, the wishlist for a Trump 2.0 administration...proposes mobilizing an array of government agencies to curb access to abortion – up to and including a national ban on abortion pills that would affect even states that protect abortion rights.” –The Guardian This vision is downright terrifying, and it isn’t coming out of nowhere — we’ve already seen MAGA Republicans enact strict abortion bans on the state level across the country. These attacks on reproductive freedom are symptoms of an ongoing assault on our democracy. Thanks to gerrymandering, radical right-wing lawmakers in artificially safe districts can pass unpopular laws — that restrict our rights — without facing real accountability. We’re working to elect Democracy Defenders at the state level to support fair maps, protect our democracy, and fight for our fundamental rights. But we’re counting on this team’s support to win critical elections in 2024 and beyond.= The honest truth is that even if Donald Trump and the Project 2025 agenda don’t make it to the White House, the extreme authors of that manifesto will still keep trying to push their plans at the state level. Project 2025 is not an empty threat — its authors and supporters are going state-by-state to dismantle our rights.
