name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Have we met before?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m the Democrats #1 target.

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54rEX9V1-Qq30WZX2yHCjvuIZSOuD-Tq1WsWmVQti-8K8K8vgnGoDTeOkwml17GEfgc3LkYtzKesiQzo9QgKjIAlDsVJCfOr4VCwm9rBr4LOrDfHC5vATYcLhvL_bHTJAHLFt3H3Omv077x5hdYI5jtOg%3D%3D)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54r_LjY7N-NvEGJ0Bn_n6V1zsm7Hun5-kJWoTV-s-O-pXBx6R2iSVjyVaG3ITqVSxcGGXPvdLFuN-68eEgiifBykfL7ScISk0YN2tOkAhsQpVHtBXMadNjvYGiQ8agbIHOMqSSkcNn1c1dPibKhvp06aQ%3D%3D)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54r9hZW6WVyDaHUgpyLcVch9UB__R7LExxJs-o6LwjQHDAQaDWyJ6NiXdex1VsS2wVdOJY84HIVUaU84FNh4zIfm249pLPUiuPjbskU-ZBctoF5-iPK2xnBEArtf6AcEpgRrLL4ltzrX6Is9or-9FOcUQ%3D%3D)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54rp0fq6w2UjyCnS3KcdGntdT4V8Qu894ZvXBjREObO949WTVkF0C0SWEST6Uee8nvqS7tcmzvgSLfM0gqB5dS_oxQOWtuleBsDxjp1hBBJfg6VnU1xsaA2WBpliFLJyyK3Gqujk56RI6Q2wQwWPCrzwg%3D%3D)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54rnKQ4q-0pcDfEuHm-krvmVE67LabCWFBZ2zF9RGoApDhMEP_k0ZJsdsAg5Sb-DiemG9MwSJ2Kz_qZBtLHXjIHVKEm-kL6YcujFhkdArjAoBicELaSZiNnrN0_qfy8jF3WS456q0hbODrzzMRxBTKk0A%3D%3D)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54r9mCDy-ae5eXWvJcLc5wSoA2LuQD1n1FozXmTX9JxanrtKQvIJr6lp4anZKR2s0rxWXPx6w4-1Cvc5UnIQolLjGj9u1dyi_9LrD9DeF3Ku-cpDEn_kMNTacp8NPXwDc3X0ggtC_UgdlAfDHFVWHIV4Q%3D%3D)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54r_9efMnAU0E-gZdp1JxPtrwsGxJYNvQqjSAtyh3cVJPJ03ifl25VDebO2dr_HE5UTQZZpyhrQC5K20wJs3Vv6ePnn5L8IihDRvEoxnR_Tg8pLAur-Jv1TIiGshAe__feaGMGg3GKUVEwByAFAOXsdTw%3D%3D)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=315a8b816a534c5181d25e4c9705d057&_e=F7SYX-aI2czbSZyXvLlPex__TJ9DaDUJk05qlxn5Rzj6ppIQxx_EjJ95CmTak3qXG7GOZlrhe0IQD-K33YVuo3WH-UizBNaVXq7PaQwErbJbG63hP2JcJmd05rU8kX41dcI17Qgk-FG8AgEry1goNxIGyzLdPj3F8V8-uugMUnmrHfKnZKEq6Sv-eS6HbnrRHVATpN_YFfX9HssxJ3of3Anqafc1fqehtEsCKMeM9TqXEZaVP2OsQFcfd35e-54rhLKjX95hwWntafpRt9hJLdop9DXrvLozcfU1wTypCNn6AycQlTIoKuHSoJV5zTqML4Yn8-lIAjpDYK8jLEsNUfyq2etGwYRzwx3RqJiavQYHLV9auZzp_5CKzicv4UcKrp2y7JMSmVAbcUNTeZWPrQ%3D%3D "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign. But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place. | That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children. | I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf. After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve. | Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them. So I got off my couch, and I ran for office. | I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities. Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first. | So, I once again decided to stop complaining and actually do something about it. So I ran for Congress! When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me. | But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started. | But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me. body:
I have a promise for you as our campaign ends. | | | | | |
---
| You’re receiving this email because of your past support for Democratic campaigns and causes. If you do not wish to hear about our progressive platform, you can [unsubscribe](https://devinhermanson.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=183f0f0d7b868d7a3cf101385&id=cc80dedaca&e=10cc7d1928).
---
| Hey Peter,
Just a note of thanks and my promise to you about the future.
About 10,000 people cast their vote for this first-time candidate. **I could not be more honored, and I promise I'm not done fighting!**
The day after the election, I got a clear sign of why it’s so important for all of us to stay involved. **I got an email from Representative Larsen**.
---
[](https://devinhermanson.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=183f0f0d7b868d7a3cf101385&id=cfb14c22fe&e=10cc7d1928)
| It was a pretty standard letter about his victory, but **once again, Larsen failed to mention the historic threat our democracy faces!**
Larsen’s email left me perplexed, and I told him so. I’ve received no reply from his campaign, but that’s where you come in.
**My promise to you is that I'm not going anywhere**. I'll be fighting for democracy, holding Rep Larsen accountable and ask that you commit to doing the same. **There are at least 10,000 of us! That’s a loud, powerful voice that won’t be ignored.**
And we can't settle for a choice between dictatorship and the status quo. We're going to demand more. **We need Larsen and the rest of Congress to act with urgency and boldness.**
I hope you'll continue with me on this journey and **help give President Kamala Harris a Congress that's ready to make history.**

Thank you for your support and passion for our country.

More soon!
\- Devin and Team Hope

PS, Let me know what you’re most fired up about in this election. What do you think our top priority should be?

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:

But it’s more than that, too. **They’re dangerous.** Project 2025, the white supremacist playbook for another Trump presidency, is an existential threat to our communities. It’s a roadmap to carry out mass detentions and deportations, dismantle LGBTQ+ rights, effectively ban abortion and contraception nationwide, and destroy our environmental protection policies. So yes, Peter, Republicans like Donald Trump and JD Vance are weird. But we must defeat them for so many more reasons. Our team has a plan to contact and mobilize over one million young voters from now until Election Day to get out the vote and push forward a vision for the country that we deserve. Friends ,
With 17 years in Congress and no bills authored or passed to his name, it’s clear Jim Jordan isn’t here to help Ohioans.
So, who’s he really working for?
Surprise, it’s billionaires like Elon Musk.
In a move that has nothing to do with helping families put food on the table or making our communities safer, Jordan has teamed up with Musk to force a nonprofit media group – dedicated to protecting brands from extremist content – out of business.
The Global Alliance for Responsible Media ensured our communities remained welcoming and safe by holding companies accountable for where they placed their ads – and it turns out a lot of brands didn’t want to advertise alongside the racist, sexist, extremist content that floods Twitter/X since Elon took over.

Here’s what happened:
First Jim Jordan launched a sham “investigation” into GARM through the House Judiciary Committee.

Then Elon Musk cited Jordan’s show trial as justification for a massive lawsuit filed against GARM just a few days ago.

Unable to fend off Elon’s billions or Jordan’s abuse of congressional power, GARM shut down its operations entirely this weekend.

His priorities couldn’t be more clear.
Instead of working for everyday Americans, Jim Jordan is acting as a concierge for pampered billionaires , pushing a warped agenda that no one asked for.
No one should be surprised that the party of bullies and abusers is forcing its will on us again . They won't stop; this is just the beginning. Everyone should be alarmed!
As someone born and raised in Ohio, I’ve dedicated my life to helping the lives of those around me—my neighbors, my community, and the people who make this state great. We deserve leaders who care about them, not about stroking the egos of billionaires. If you agree, contribute today, and let’s fight for real change. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240812_forced_speech_link1]
As your representative, I would never follow the whims of whatever dangerous idea Elon Musk is cooking up next because of his bizarre personal and self-confidence issues.
Musk and Jordan are two peas in a conspiracy theory-loving pod, and neither should be anywhere near the halls of Congress.
To Musk and Jordan, I say this: try therapy boys. It’s much cheaper than buying the government and forcing people to like you.
Jim Jordan and the billionaires backing the ULTRA-MAGA agenda know they can’t win on the issues that actually matter to us—like affordable healthcare, quality education, and job security—so they’re focused on controlling what we see, hear, and say.
So much for the party of freedom, right?
This is not the kind of representation we need in Congress.
If you’re tired of watching our voices get drowned out by money and power, now is the time to act.
Contribute to our campaign today, and let’s put an end to this kind of backward leadership. We need representatives who actually care about our communities, not those who cater to the whims of the richest among us. | Peter,

In case you missed it, Trump’s campaign is going after me for calling attention to his plan to fire federal workers – a direct threat to Virginia’s economy, Virginia’s federal employees, and thousands of Virginia jobs.

Under “Agenda 47” on his campaign website, he’s promising to bring back the reckless Schedule F executive order on “Day One.” He plans on firing public servants, those who have dedicated their lives to service — and then replacing them with Trump loyalists.

Virginia has more than 140,000 federal workers. Trump’s agenda would put the livelihoods of thousands of Virginians at risk.

The Virginians who have dedicated their careers to serving our country — including scientists, civilian DoD employees, law enforcement officers, infectious disease researchers, attorneys, and accountants — do not deserve this level of contempt.

After I called attention to this terrible idea, Trump’s campaign attacked me and tried to backpedal Agenda 47’s disastrous impacts on Virginia’s economy. Don’t be fooled – Virginians know what’s at stake this November.

| | Dear Fellow Patriot,I just wanted to say **_**_thank you_**_** _-_ thank you for opening this email. . . . Because I know that your inbox is probably . . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own. So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me.**[**Can I count on you to stick with me through November?**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=bedae72cfd0b4279b752d3f92ddd7bec&_e=qaNHyh73LC4BIoVWQu5vggPbxrGtBQS1HCWAbRUMQ4O5G-nHe3wrz5eWV0331WqRtFWdy4UAZTLCmGm0VKsdM8GrCV3yU75drIOBLrBdbU8hb_vXuqtu-dzpM_UwZpZcbFppwQOCZaKWh7A2q_SIZVs10gOkJUXtxOVij1Yh_i87ecmpQdCP0uISUulyp2tcRKVQBeKP4Y9SyyDAiW2cE1e8T_3K5gsW3mMWUAN0EjzSP5Fnjjw61t9gR2LrppQ5ouFkqUONwZhuudPNaElHQZYwmgxXRqcxtthPj8_AYDibavqqxyGF2JN_zJTWITz_rViWcwBbakW-LYwwlJwdQu0ru_Duq41ZTyLoSZ7g1kgbluvx1L7r4gWl8n5y-Vyd)** Fellow Patriot, I hope you’ll **[**support my campaign team today**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=bedae72cfd0b4279b752d3f92ddd7bec&_e=qaNHyh73LC4BIoVWQu5vggPbxrGtBQS1HCWAbRUMQ4O5G-nHe3wrz5eWV0331WqRtFWdy4UAZTLCmGm0VKsdM8GrCV3yU75drIOBLrBdbU8hb_vXuqtu-dzpM_UwZpZcbFppwQOCZaKWh7A2q_SIZVs10gOkJUXtxOVij1Yh_i87ecmpQdCP0uISUulyp2tcRKVQBeKP4Y9SyyDAiW2cE1e8T_3K5gsW3mMWUAN0EjzdbXSC-nWRwZCiKtAkXH4RH2BEX-oF6xlyO6gBYJbRZy3-R0JGqPcdgKzW-F1tNEu-SA93OBEAQa_03sUKFGMMAPqaNHNXQIosDxe9FKilog39JRgLjLYfFbU4H_DTdkkhiKIm4H841k0A0nGqTUwR)** and stay up to date through election day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake. If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring common sense leadership to our country's most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is _**_pray for me and my election._**_ And friend, in addition to your prayers, if you're able, **[**a small contribution to my campaign**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=bedae72cfd0b4279b752d3f92ddd7bec&_e=qaNHyh73LC4BIoVWQu5vggPbxrGtBQS1HCWAbRUMQ4O5G-nHe3wrz5eWV0331WqRtFWdy4UAZTLCmGm0VKsdM8GrCV3yU75drIOBLrBdbU8hb_vXuqtu-dzpM_UwZpZcbFppwQOCZaKWh7A2q_SIZVs10gOkJUXtxOVij1Yh_i87ecmpQdCP0uISUulyp2tcRKVQBeKP4Y9SyyDAiW2cE1e8T_3K5gsW3mMWUAN0EjxrhsVXiwTcdqD369cek1NiSnGqJJwDt0W66hEHbqiHVJXoxiTpQRp9jWBLu6GehsKZtylASRJC8Ou6VcAh1VtXQcXQI0Grn1lrv1ZEQb5NCr-qU6I8bFog4X6HhJQBwIm7pVZO_rMkfELvIn4AjgsM)** goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign. Because the last thing the Democrats want to see is support from hundreds of individual American patriots donating to my campaign and dreaming of a new Conservative California.So, I'm glad this email reached you, and I hope I can count on your support to defeat Adam Schiff in November.

| Friend,
---
| Tomorrow, **Tuesday, August 13th, is Primary Election Day** in Vermont! I hope you, your family and friends get out there and make your voices heard.

All polls in Vermont close at 7:00 p.m. and you can find your polling location by [clicking here](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=520c8b6ea9&e=19cebfe173).

There are many great candidates running for the State Legislature this year. The current Super Majority in Montpelier is so far out of balance and out of touch, and **we desperately need more common sense in the State House**. After the Primary, we will continue our focus on getting more pragmatic candidates elected in November who will actually work with me to make our state a more affordable place to live, work, raise a family, do business, and retire in.

If you’d like to support some of these candidates,[ click here and we can connect you to ones running near where you live](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=b29053365c&e=19cebfe173).

In the Lt. Governor primary tomorrow, I will also be voting for John Rodgers. I’ve known John for years and worked with him while he was in the House and the Senate, and I’ve seen firsthand how committed he is to rural Vermont.

John knows what hard work is all about. He also knows that the solutions to our problems do not come from the extremes of either party — but somewhere in the middle.

**Again, don’t forget to vote! **

Gov. Phil

Peter,
Donald Trump can desperately try to deny his involvement with Project 2025 all he wants, but everyone on the planet knows Trump’s word doesn’t mean much. **The fact of the matter is his fingerprints are all over it:**
* It was written almost entirely by people who worked in the previous Trump administration.

* JD Vance wrote a book foreword for the guy in charge of it.

* And **Trump himself took a private plane flight with its director** and told a conference room full of people _“They’re going to lay the groundwork and detail plans for exactly what our movement will do."_

[**Will you pitch in $3 to power our progressive movement and help us fight back against Trump’s Project 2025 agenda?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240812.m-w83_&refcode=em20240812-4195&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4195%2E420207%2E7GHQoL)
**Project 2025 is Donald Trump's blueprint for destroying our democracy.** It promises the far-right will not rest until they control our bodies, education, healthcare, and nearly every other aspect of our lives.
It calls for crushing labor unions, banning abortion nationwide, implementing state-sanctioned discrimination against LGBTQ+ people, and putting religion at the center of government.
It would replace thousands of civil service employees – the people who make our government function – with MAGA loyalist appointees, effectively replacing competence with cronyism.
**We must stand up to defend our democracy and ensure that Project 2025 never becomes reality.** Our progressive movement has the momentum now, but we need your help to keep it going all the way through Election Day and beyond.
[**Will you make a grassroots donation of $3 to Pramila’s campaign today to help us stop Project 2025 and make our progressive agenda a reality instead?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240812.m-w83_&refcode=em20240812-4195&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4195%2E420207%2E7GHQoL)

| **_Peter,

Did you see this?_**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90702804/491386765/1985506197?refcode=BLU_EM_AMDC_2024-08-12_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkxNzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTcwMjA2NGQtZjY1OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZGJmYzRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wMAGI_QkSvqfAtVP1rcoPHnAtgdQKPQC0VW5F3XCIGw=)
That GOP House candidate is none other than my opponent, Neil Parrott.

This is deeply concerning: Parrot has a troubling track record on reproductive healthcare. He once opposed IVF coverage for same-sex couples, claiming it would create a “false sense of equality.” This is just one example of his extreme views, which threaten to roll back the progress we've made in ensuring reproductive freedom for all.

As Republicans across the country rush to restrict reproductive healthcare and the Supreme Court threw IVF into legal question this summer, we can’t afford any more anti-choice politicians in Congress. This isn’t just a theoretical threat—it's happening right now, and Parrott is part of that dangerous agenda.

If elected, Neil Parrott would bring these invasive policies to Congress, putting countless families at risk and undermining basic healthcare rights. We can’t afford to let that happen.

I’m running to bring common sense back to Congress and end these harmful Republican policies. But I can’t do it alone. I need your support to win this race and protect the freedoms that so many have fought for.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. clean_body: This is the honest truth about Sam Brown.| | | America gave him a Purple Heart and I gave him my whole heart. I first met Sam Brown in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban. He was injured by a roadside bomb and had a long road to recovery. I was assigned as his dietitian in rehab and was very impressed by him. Here was a young man terribly injured while serving his country, but his heart was full of faith. He fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. And even when it became clear that he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he didn't skip a beat. Sam had to relearn everything. He had prepared for his entire life to spend his career fighting for his country in the military. After his life plans were dashed in just 60 seconds, he re-focused his vision on serving others in a new way. Before we were married, and before we were even dating, Sam and I became friends. I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced, and he was honest with me. He was concerned for my Salvation – and for that matter so was I. He challenged me to reconnect with God and start going to church again. As he and I grew closer, he helped me rediscover my faith. Now here we are 15 years later. We have 3 kids, I'm a Bible-believing momma, and Sam is running for Senate to keep serving our nation and restore hope, leadership, and accountability. I'm endlessly grateful that God put him in my life. Sam is a warrior, a hero, a leader. Thank you for your consideration, Captain Amy BrownU.S. Army, ret. # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 12, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

_**FORMER MAYOR FAULCONER RECEIVES ENDORSEMENT OF THE CARLSBAD POLICE OFFICERS ASSOCIATION**_
SAN DIEGO, CA -- Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, announced the endorsement of the Carlsbad Police Officers Association.
It is the mission of the Carlsbad Police Officers Association to work in partnership with the community to continuously provide a safe and secure environment in which to live, work and visit.
_**“Kevin Faulconer has been a stalwart supporter of police officers throughout his tenure as mayor of San Diego. When times got tough, he never turned his back on the men and women who keep our neighborhoods safe,” said Steven Evans, President of the Carlsbad Police Officers Association. “We need a supervisor who will continue to support our police, not one who is actively supported by defund the police activists. Kevin Faulconer is the clear choice, and we wholeheartedly support him and his efforts to keep all of our communities safe.”**_ _**“Our men and women work diligently to keep our communities safe, and they should be supported every step of the way,” said former Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for supervisor. “Terra Lawson-Remer has a record of cozying up to activists who support defunding the police and have raised money for her campaign. That’s the best way to signal where you stand. Simply put, she’s too extreme for San Diego County, and she’s failed to perform the basics of her job. It’s time for new leadership who will stand with our police and work to make progress on the issues voters care about. And that's what I'll do a supervisor.”**_
Under Faulconer's mayoral leadership, San Diego consistently ranked as the safest or one of the safest big cities in the country. As mayor, he pushed for and passed the City's most-sweeping recruitment and retention program that helped to rebuild the San Diego Police Department’s dwindling ranks. When Faulconer left office in 2020, the San Diego Police Department had reached a 10-year high in police staffing.
Since entering the race last July, Faulconer has outraised Tera Lawson-Remer and garnered the endorsements of law and order organizations like the San DiegoPolice Officer’s Association, the San Diego Deputy District Attorney’s Association and now the Carlsbad Police Officer’s Association, making him the clear law and order candidate in the race. As Supervisor, voters can expect Kevin Faulconer will be a strong advocate for cleaning up our streets, addressing the growing homelessness crisis and support the needs of the law enforcement community in order to keep all neighborhoods safe regardless of zip code or background.
_To learn more about Kevin Faulconer and his campaign for Supervisor, visit www.kevinfaulconer.com_

name: Andrew Yang
subject: The Human-Centered Economy
body:
If the only measurements are cost and efficiency, more and more of us are going to lose to the machines. AI will get smarter and faster. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b1880e36c7&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
|
---
| Hello, I hope that your summer is going great. My kids don’t start school until Labor Day so we are milking the summer for all it can give.

4 years ago I ran for President arguing for Universal Basic Income based on the idea that AI was coming and was going to do away with many American jobs.

Today, AI is here and gathering steam, and is already displacing workers in different fields. One joke going around is, “Why can’t AI do my dishes?” Instead it’s consuming many cognitive tasks, from coding to writing to art and design to legal work. Friends who are starting companies marvel at how they are hiring fewer people for roles that now get handled by software. At the same time, friends who have started automation companies are seeing continuing growth and adoption.

There are almost 2 million call center workers in the United States. I believe most will eventually be replaced by AI. That’s an obvious application, but many will be affected in more unobvious ways. Perhaps relatedly, I’ve had multiple friends lose their jobs lately in finance, tech and media. Most of these people were my age – in their 40s – and were on the pricier side. Organizations will always look to do more with less, and some are presently pruning costs.

The question is, what lies ahead for human workers?

Here’s the core idea: If the only measurements are cost and efficiency, more and more of us are going to lose to the machines. AI will get smarter and faster in ways that we cannot.

I think people are waking up to this. 4 years ago, people would sometimes talk about reskilling and being lifelong learners as if we can all scramble above the water line if only we’re a little more nimble. Now, there’s a growing recognition that this is going to be unrealistic.

I continue to hold that addressing poverty is the most direct and concrete way we can help people. Humanity Forward is lobbying Congress for a revival of the enhanced child tax credit. There is a ton of needless suffering and deprivation in this country and it is fueling our politics in dangerous ways.

The biggest question is how people will find structure, purpose, fulfillment and community through their day-to-day activities, both today and tomorrow.

I would get asked this on the campaign trail several years ago, and I would sometimes describe how my wife Evelyn was at home with our children, one of whom is on the autism spectrum. How much was her time and work valued at in our current marketplace? The answer is “zero” even though we all know that her work might be some of the most important and valuable that a person can do.

Imagine an economy where education and nurturing has its own value, along with arts and creativity and health and wellness. I joke sometimes that we should probably be getting paid to go to the gym, because it’s great for society and saves us all money if we stay healthy.

A multipolar economy is our way out of the grinding wheels of the machine – that we build an economy around human values and helping people live fruitful lives. Our time is the most important resource we have to offer, independent of what the cost-based marketplace currently assigns us. There can be more ways to both measure value and value our time.

Last week on Freakonomics Radio I was asked what a human-centered economy could look like in practice. I responded, “Let’s say I tutor your child at math. That’s what I’m good at. I get a 2-hour time credit for my work. I then give it to someone else in return for their help cleaning my garage. I’m not great at that. That person then gives the time credit to someone else in return for a homecooked meal, which is also something I’m not good at. Everyone has something that they can contribute. If we start valuing and trading people’s time in new ways, we could enable a different sort of economy that works for many more of us.”

This is not a new idea; Stephen Dubner of Freakonomics became interested in Timebanking when he read a book by Edgar Cahn called “No More Throw-away People.” Edgar Cahn was Bobby Kennedy’s speechwriter in the 1960s, a time when the war on poverty was front and center. Technology could enable time banking or trading in powerful new ways. It’s also making the development of a human-centered economy all the more important.

If we’re going to lose a race to the machines, perhaps we should change the racetrack and measurements to something we can win and be happy about. How do we build an economy that works for people? By seeing to it that there are ways to create meaning, purpose and value for as many as possible.

My extended interview appears this week on the [podcast](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=132a34aec3&e=0f227c2ae3) and you can check out the Freakonomics interview [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=9ab2deb347&e=0f227c2ae3).

I know that this may seem utopian to some of you reading this – and I don’t think that’s a bad thing. The fact is that we’re going to veer toward either dystopia or utopia over time, and I’d vastly prefer the latter. Which are we trending towards right now? Someone’s got to paint the picture of abundance and possibility – it might as well be us.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

name: Jill Stein for President
subject: Gavin Newsom escalates his war on the unhoused
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Jill Stein believes housing is a human right

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newson_escalates_against_homel&n=1)
---
Peter,
Last month, the Supreme Court handed down a draconian ruling that gave cities the green light to remove homeless encampments from public land. This ruling essentially made it a crime to be unable to afford the rising costs of housing. We’re told time and time again that only the anti-Democratic Party can save us from a reactionary right-wing Supreme Court. But California’s deep blue Governor Gavin Newsom not only welcomed the ruling, he provided a friend of the court brief urging this heartless outcome. Now he’s threatening to withhold funds from cities and counties that fail to tear down the only place that California’s rising homeless population can rest their heads and store their belongings. Lots of myths pervade the public discourse on homelessness. People struggling with poverty are dehumanized in our media and cruelly targeted by politicians on both sides of the corrupt duopoly. Too few people know that 40% of unhoused people have jobs. But those jobs don’t pay a living wage and aren’t keeping up with the outrageous rent increases that have shot up as much as 30% – far outpacing both wages and inflation! Many Americans are just a paycheck or two away from losing their housing. It doesn’t have to be this way. Gavin Newsom and the anti-Democratic Party work hand-in-hand with the reactionary Republicans to “solve” homelessness through the criminalization of being too poor to afford housing. Newsom is eager to punish cities and counties that refuse to treat human beings like trash to be swept off the streets and thrown in jail for the “crime” of poverty. Jill Stein believes that housing is a human right. Under Jill’s administration she’ll take on the crisis of housing with a Homes Guarantee, a plan to build 15 million green, union built public housing units over the next 10 years, and universal rent control to rein in the surging rental costs that are pricing working people out of the housing market and into the streets. Jill is fighting for a livable minimum wage of at least $25 an hour that will assure American workers are paid fairly for their labor and can afford stable housing. [_**Peter, can you donate today to make sure that Jill’s humanistic vision that puts people over profits is on the ballot all over the nation?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newson_escalates_against_homel&n=2)

In solidarity and gratitude, Team Jill Stein

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

[1]Justice Democrats

With less than 24 hours left to go in our primary, we had to make sure you
saw this breaking news, Peter:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240812-io.VcyCYC&refcode=em20240812-35905&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35905%2E1203867%2Etz1lLi ]The Intercept: “Inside the 'Zionists for Don Samuels' WhatsApp Group
Raising Big Money to Oust Ilhan Omar”

According to The Intercept, members of a WhatsApp group named "Zionists
for Don Samuels" have been coordinating and building coalitions with Trump
donors and "alt-right Christian Neo Nazis" to support Ilhan's opponent and
flood outside cash into Minnesota's 5th district during the final days of
this race.

Take a look:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240812-io.VcyCYC&refcode=em20240812-35905&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35905%2E1203867%2Etz1lLi ]The Intercept: “The members of the group — which included a consultant
who at the time was working for the Samuels campaign as well as far-flung
political donors — discussed raising six-figure sums for a political
action committee, strategies for campaign phone banks, and an effort to
marshal Republican voters to boost Samuels in Tuesday’s open primary.”

You may have seen us reach out about the AIPAC-affiliated outside spending
group dropping tens of thousands of dollars on attack mailers against
Ilhan and raising huge sums of money in the hours after Cori Bush's defeat
in Missouri.

Or about right-wing internet trolls mobilizing Republicans to vote for Don
in Tuesday's primary.

These are the people we're dealing with,
Peter. So please:

to stand with Ilhan so we can fight back? This is an important moment for
our campaign, and a critical time for our movement to show we're in this
fight together.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240812-io.VcyCYC&refcode=em20240812-35905&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=35905%2E1203867%2Etz1lLi ]Contribute $5

We've got just one day left in this primary, and we can't afford to leave
anything to chance.

Thanks for anything you can chip in today.

In solidarity,

subject: HOPE

body:
Peter,
**I am filled with HOPE about our future — now more than ever.**
And that may sound strange. Because the challenges we face—from the assault on abortion rights and voting rights, to persistent gun violence, to disasters brought on by climate change—are some of the toughest we’ve ever faced.
But hope isn’t passive. Hope is knowing that if we work together, we can build a better future for all of us.
We can build an economy that works for working people, not just big corporations.
We can restore abortion rights and civil rights for all Americans.
We can save our planet and our democracy for generations to come.
**Building a better Texas and a better nation doesn’t come easy. We have to fight for it.**
That’s why I’m so proud to have you as part of our team, Peter. Because your continued support of our movement shows you’ve joined the fight for our future.****

# A Forward-Thinking Representative
---
| As a scientist, I trust the experts and know climate change isn’t a hoax.I am running for office to build a smarter government. One that funds and builds the critical infrastructure we need to support our rapidly changing district and world.
As a science and tech expert working for Senator Elizabeth Warren, I helped draft [legislation to electrify our school buses](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=3a914f6f44&e=395a33a3d2), saving our children’s future on their ride to school.
Only recently did I learn that my work was included as part of the groundbreaking [Inflation Reduction Act passed in 2022 by President Biden](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=cbf722aad5&e=395a33a3d2)!
---
[](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=78aff4030f&e=395a33a3d2)
|
**I always walk my talk.**
Meanwhile, my opponent [denies climate change](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=a238803c39&e=395a33a3d2)and [opposes climate-friendly legislation](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=c895788b84&e=395a33a3d2), putting us in harm’s way every single day.
**We must put an end to this anti-science movement.**
The longer we bury our heads in the sand, the more expensive the solutions become. As your next Congresswoman, I am committed to forward-thinking legislation that puts our community’s future first.
[**Can you contribute $21, $210, or $2100 today to send me to Congress and**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=ef10d7b24f&e=395a33a3d2)[**elect our nation’s first Congresswoman with a STEM PhD?**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=db2e73d21d&e=395a33a3d2)**!**

If you received a mail-in ballot and have not yet turned it in, make sure your ballot is received by 8 PM tomorrow. You can turn your ballot in to or to If you need any more information about voting, Thank you for making your voices heard tomorrow and in every election. Happy voting! — Tina Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota Tina Smith for Minnesota PO Box 14362 St. Paul, MN 55114 United States | | Contributions or gifts to Tina Smith for Minnesota are not tax-deductible.
